cards.name: 炼甲师

cards.flavor: 甲不在身，在心。

cards.name: 镇山掌

cards.flavor: 掌落如山，不求快，只求重。

art.subject: a shaven-headed warrior monk standing before a great bronze bell, striking it with his elbow, visible rings of sound rippling outward, full body in a wide stance

cards.name: 撼岳
cards.text: 造成等同于你[护甲]值的伤害。

cards.flavor: 我不动，你撞上来，便是我在出手。

cards.flavor: 被她看一眼，手里的刀就重了三分。

art.subject: a close-up of a woman's icy pale eyes beneath a dark hood, frost forming on her lashes, reflected in her pupils a hesitant warrior lowering his blade

cards.name: 寒潭灵

cards.flavor: 潭底千年不化的寒气，化作了一个小小的影子。

art.subject: a small translucent water spirit rising from a black mountain pool, its body like flowing ice with glowing pale eyes, frost spreading across the water around it

cards.name: 守烬真人
cards.text: 你的[余烬]上限+{e}。每回合你首次在应对中打出牌后，抽{n}张牌。

upgrade.text: 你的[余烬]上限+{e}。每当你在应对中打出牌，抽{n}张牌。

cards.flavor: 他守的不是火，是火熄之后仍愿意亮着的那一点。

art.subject: an elderly Taoist in layered grey-blue robes holding a small brass brazier with three steady embers, seated cross-legged on a floating stone, calm half-smile, dark background

cards.name: 霜弦弩手
cards.text: [远射]。攻击单位时，对其施加{f}层[冰冻]。

upgrade.text: [远射]，[连斩]。攻击单位时，对其施加{f}层[冰冻]。

cards.flavor: 弦上结霜，箭出无声。

art.subject: a crossbowwoman kneeling on a snowy rampart aiming a crossbow strung with a glittering frost string, the loaded bolt tipped with ice, breath misting, cold blue moonlight

cards.name: 凝霜掌
cards.text: 造成{d}点伤害；若目标为单位，施加{f}层[冰冻]。
cards.flavor: 掌心一点寒，敌身三尺冰。

art.subject: a pale-robed martial artist pressing a frost-rimed palm against an enemy's chest, ice crystals spreading across the foe's armor in a fern pattern, breath fogging in the cold air

cards.name: 霜封
cards.text: [延时]1：[判定]阴纹——施加{f}层[冰冻]；阳纹——施加{w}层[虚弱]。
cards.flavor: 符上的霜，要等天意落笔才肯结冰。

art.subject: a paper talisman covered in frost sigils pinned to an enemy's back, thin white frost creeping outward from it across the dark armor, a fate card faintly glowing above

cards.name: 冰魄
cards.text: [藏锋]。[应]：对一个敌人造成{d}点伤害并施加{f}层[冰冻]；若在应对中打出，额外施加{h}层[冰冻]。
cards.flavor: 魄散则形凝。

art.subject: a glowing shard of blue ice spirit-light piercing a charging beast, the beast's limbs freezing mid-stride, frozen mist trailing behind the shard

cards.name: 寒川封冻
cards.text: 持续{n}回合。处于[冰冻]的敌人受到的伤害+{d}。敌方回合开始时，对攻击力最高的敌方单位施加{f}层[冰冻]。
cards.flavor: 寒川一夜冻结，封住的不只是水。

art.subject: a wide frozen river valley at night with enemy soldiers trapped knee-deep in the ice, a lone zither player seated on a rock at the bank, aurora-blue light over the ice

cards.name: 积羽沉舟
cards.text: 造成{d}点伤害。本场战斗你每在应对中打出过一张牌，此伤害+{e}。
cards.flavor: 每一次后手，都是压在船上的一根羽毛。

art.subject: countless pale feathers drifting down and piling onto a war boat until it cracks and sinks into black water, a stoic armored figure watching from the shore

cards.name: 冰川巨像
cards.text: [坚守]。[起势]：对所有敌方单位施加{f}层[冰冻]。

upgrade.text: [坚守]。[起势]：对所有敌人施加{f}层[冰冻]。

cards.flavor: 它醒来的那一步，整条河都停了。

art.subject: a colossal humanoid of ancient blue glacier ice stepping out of a frozen waterfall, full body, frost spreading from its footfall across the ground, tiny warriors fleeing at its feet

cards.name: 后发先至
cards.text: [藏锋]。[应]：获得{a}点[护甲]；若在应对中打出，再对宣告行动的敌人造成等同于你[护甲]值的伤害。
cards.flavor: 他出手在先，我到得却比他早。

art.subject: an armored master catching an enemy's blade on his forearm plate while his other fist lands squarely on the attacker's jaw, both motions caught in the same frozen instant

cards.name: 叠嶂
cards.text: 获得{a}点[护甲]。若你已有[护甲]，再获得{b}点[护甲]。
cards.flavor: 一重山外一重山。

art.subject: layer upon layer of dark mountain ridges rising behind a lone guardian like stacked shields, mist pooling between the peaks, pale dawn light on the ridgelines

cards.name: 引岳
cards.text: [藏锋]。仅限应对：将该行动的目标改为你生命值最高的[坚守]单位，该单位获得{a}点[护甲]。

upgrade.text: [藏锋]。仅限应对：将该行动的目标改为一个友方角色，其获得{a}点[护甲]。

cards.flavor: 来势再猛，也要先过山门。

art.subject: a stone guardian stepping sideways into the path of a spear thrust meant for a robed woman behind it, the spear point skidding off its chest in a shower of sparks

cards.name: 以彼之道
cards.text: [藏锋]。仅限应对：取消该行动；若其为攻击，对宣告行动的敌人造成等同于其攻击力{m}倍的伤害。
cards.flavor: 你的力气，你自己收着。

art.subject: a calm swordswoman turning an enemy's own spear back into him with a circular parry, the spear's force visualized as a reversed arc of blue light, dramatic side lighting

cards.name: 镇岳力士
cards.text: [坚守]。[起势]：你的主帅获得{a}点[护甲]。
cards.flavor: 镇岳门的力士，一人抵得一道城墙。

art.subject: a towering bare-armed strongman in dark blue sash raising a massive stone slab overhead as a shield, full body, muscles taut, dust falling from the slab

cards.name: 镇岳山门
cards.text: 我方回合开始时，至多保留{k}点[护甲]。
cards.flavor: 山门三百年未曾开过，也未曾破过。

art.subject: a colossal stone gate carved into a cliff face with two guardian reliefs, heavy doors shut, snow on the lintel, tiny figures on the steps for scale

cards.name: 镇岳锤

cards.flavor: 锤头是一块山骨，落下去的时候，脚下的地也跟着沉一寸。

cards.name: 镇山符

upgrade.text: 挂在一个友方角色身上。[延时]1：[判定]{mountain}山纹——其获得{m}点[护甲]；其余——其获得{a}点[护甲]。然后你抽{n}张牌。

cards.flavor: 符上画的是山。命里若也有山，便稳了。

cards.name: 山君怒

cards.flavor: 山不常怒。怒则万物伏。

cards.name: 朔风

cards.name: 震岳锤
cards.text: 造成{d}点伤害并施加[眩晕]。
cards.flavor: 一锤下去，对面连自己要做什么都忘了。

upgrade.text: 装备时，获得{a}点[护甲]。你的[护甲]被击破时，对所有敌人造成{d}点伤害。

cards.flavor: 冰封千日，碎只一瞬。

cards.name: 岳压
cards.text: 造成{d}点伤害，再造成等同于你[护甲]值一半的伤害。
cards.flavor: 拳头不重，重的是拳后那座山。

cards.text: [藏锋]。[应]：获得{a}点[护甲]；若在应对中打出，对宣告行动的敌人施加{w}层[虚弱]。
cards.flavor: 一声清响，刀势便偏了半寸。

upgrade.text: 召唤两个「山岩」（[坚守]）。你的主帅获得{a}点[护甲]。

upgrade.text: [藏锋]。仅限应对：取消该行动，并对所有敌人施加{f}层[冰冻]。

cards.flavor: 琴弦断了最后一根。天地一同屏住了呼吸。

cards.text: 抽{n}张牌。本场战斗你的[余烬]上限+{e}。[燃尽]。

upgrade.text: 抽{n}张牌。本场战斗你的[余烬]上限+{e}。

cards.flavor: 火不必烧旺，只要不灭。

art.subject: a meditating disciple seated on a cold stone ledge, a few glowing embers orbiting slowly around her cupped hands, snow falling softly in the dark background

cards.text: 你的[余烬]上限+{e}。每回合你首次在应对中打出牌后，重置{r}枚[源]。

cards.text: [坚守]。

cards.name: 荆盾卫
cards.flavor: 撞我的盾，先问问盾上的刺。

art.subject: a guard crouched behind a round iron shield studded with long black spikes, half body, eyes narrowed over the rim, sparks glancing off the spikes

cards.name: 负碑玄龟
cards.text: 防御坐骑：你的主帅深度+1。我方回合结束时，你的主帅获得{a}点[护甲]。

upgrade.text: 防御坐骑：你的主帅深度+1。我方回合结束时，你的主帅与所有[坚守]单位获得{a}点[护甲]。

cards.flavor: 它背上驮的碑，刻着镇岳门历代门主的名字。

art.subject: a giant black tortoise with a carved stone stele on its shell, a rider seated in front of the stele, plodding through shallow river mist, side view

cards.name: 回风掌
cards.text: [藏锋]。[应]：获得{a}点[护甲]；若在应对中打出，再对宣告行动的敌人造成{d}点伤害。
cards.flavor: 风从哪里来，便送回哪里去。

art.subject: a martial artist spinning to deflect an incoming blade with a swirling palm, a visible spiral of wind throwing the attacker off balance, dynamic diagonal composition

cards.text: [坚守]，[棘刺]{t}。存活时，我方回合开始时保留全部[护甲]。
cards.flavor: 北方之神，负山而眠。它醒着的时候，什么都不会被带走。

art.subject: the divine Black Tortoise entwined with a great serpent, its shell a jagged dark mountain range, standing guard in swirling northern mist, full body, faint starlight on the shell

cards.name: 余音
cards.text: [浮光]。[应]：获得{a}点[护甲]；若在应对中打出，对宣告行动的敌人造成{d}点伤害。
cards.flavor: 弦已停，音未绝。

art.subject: a faint shimmering ripple of sound lingering in cold air above a zither string, forming a thin translucent shield shape, minimal composition

cards.name: 山岩
cards.text: [坚守]。
cards.flavor: 山上掉下来的一块，也是山。

art.subject: a large mossy boulder etched with a faint guardian rune, sitting squarely on a battlefield, subtle blue glow in the rune, low angle

cards.name: 古木撼地
cards.text: 对一个敌人造成等于你攻击力最高的友方单位攻击力{m}倍的伤害。
cards.flavor: 它只是翻了个身。

art.subject: a colossal tree spirit slamming its root-fist into the ground, a shockwave of splintered earth racing toward a distant enemy, dust and leaves exploding upward

cards.name: 秋实
cards.text:
[延时]{t}，挂在一个友方角色身上。
[判定]：{moon}月纹——召唤{n}个「灵苗」，然后所有友方单位获得+{b}/+{b}；其他命纹——所有友方单位获得+{a}/+{a}。点数≥{h}时，额外抽{d}张牌。

upgrade.text: [统御]：相邻友方单位+{a}攻击，受到的伤害-{r}，并具有[坚守]。

cards.flavor: 树伯不上阵。树伯只要站在那里，阵就不会散。

art.subject: an elderly treant holding a tall staff hung with green silk banners, standing behind a line of small forest spirits, banners rippling in warm wind

cards.name: 树皮甲
cards.text: 获得{a}点[护甲]。
cards.flavor: 老树挨过的刀，比你见过的都多。

art.subject: a robed figure raising an arm as layered plates of living bark grow over their forearm and shoulder, moss glowing faintly in the seams

cards.text: 造成{d}点伤害。

art.subject: a thick green vine lashing forward like a whip through a misty forest clearing, leaves scattering from the impact, warm light from the upper left

cards.flavor: 它啄食落叶，也啄食落下的魂。

art.subject: a crow with feathers like rotted bark and fungus sprouting from its back, perched on a dead branch, eyes glowing green

cards.text: 每回合第一次有其他友方单位死亡时，抽{n}张牌，并获得{e}枚本回合可用的源。
cards.flavor: 它开花的时候，林子里总有什么刚刚死去。

cards.text:
[坚守]。[滋长]{g}。

[坚守]。[滋长]{g}。

cards.flavor: 柏将军不催兵。它只教它们往上长。

cards.name: 萤灯婆
cards.text: [远射]。你的回合结束时，召唤{n}个「灵苗」。
cards.flavor: 她提着灯走一夜，身后便跟了一夜的小东西。

art.subject: an old woman in a straw cloak holding a paper lantern full of fireflies, a trail of tiny glowing sapling spirits following behind her on a night path

cards.name: 林海行军
cards.text: 所有友方单位本回合获得+{a}攻击，并获得[疾行]。
cards.flavor: 那一夜，山上的林子向山下走了十里。

art.subject: a vast army of tree spirits, beasts of bark and tiny sapling soldiers marching down a mountainside in a single surging tide of green, moonlight on their leaves

cards.name: 移花接木
cards.text: [应]：将该敌方行动的目标改为一个友方单位，并使其获得{a}点[护甲]。
cards.flavor: 你要砍的那棵树，早就换了。

art.subject: a falling blade deflected midair as petals swirl and a sturdy bark-armored spirit suddenly stands where a robed woman was, her silhouette fading into blossoms

cards.name: 心材坠
cards.text: 宝物。每当一个友方单位死亡，主帅获得{a}点[护甲]。
cards.flavor: 取自千年老木的芯，戴着它，就听得见林子里每一声叹息。

art.subject: a pendant carved from dark amber heartwood showing concentric growth rings, hanging from a jade cord, glowing softly in a cupped palm

cards.name: 建木
cards.text:
[坚守]。[滋长]{g}。
[起势]：所有其他友方单位获得[滋长]{k}。

upgrade.text:
[坚守]。[滋长]{g}。[统御]：相邻友方单位+{a}攻击。
[起势]：所有其他友方单位获得[滋长]{k}。

cards.flavor: 传说天地未分时，众神沿着它上下。如今它只为万木庭长。

art.subject: a gigantic world tree whose trunk rises beyond the clouds, its roots forming a vast terraced city of smaller trees, golden light pouring down through the canopy

cards.name: 灯笼菌
cards.text: [统御]：相邻友方单位+{a}攻击。

upgrade.text: [统御]：相邻友方单位+{a}攻击并具有[汲命]。

cards.flavor: 后排的光，是给前排看路的。

art.subject: a tall glowing mushroom with a lantern-shaped cap, amber light spilling from its gills onto small spirits gathered around its stem, dark forest behind

cards.name: 苔灵童
cards.text:
[起势]：召唤{n}个「灵苗」。
[献]：召唤{n}个「灵苗」。
cards.flavor: 它走到哪儿，哪儿就多出一个玩伴。

art.subject: a small child-like spirit made of moss and pebbles, leading a tiny glowing sapling by the hand across a forest floor, spores floating in warm light

cards.name: 老樟
cards.text: [坚守]。[滋长]{g}
cards.flavor: 村口那棵樟树，替三代人挡过风。

art.subject: an ancient camphor tree spirit with a gnarled face in its trunk, broad branches spread protectively, roots gripping the ground like fists

cards.name: 催芽
cards.text:
一个友方单位获得+{a}/+{a}与[滋长]{g}。
[献]：随机一个友方单位获得[滋长]{g}。
cards.flavor: 一滴晨露，一句咒，一夜长一寸。

art.subject: cupped hands releasing a single glowing dewdrop onto a sprout that surges upward in a spiral of green light

cards.name: 归土
cards.text: 消灭一个友方单位，对所有敌人造成等于其生命值的伤害。

upgrade.text: 消灭一个友方单位，对所有敌人造成等于其生命值的伤害，然后召唤{n}个「灵苗」。

cards.flavor: 它倒下时，大地替它还手。

art.subject: a great tree spirit collapsing into the earth as a ring of roots and splintered wood erupts outward from where it fell, striking shadowy foes

cards.name: 织根婆
cards.text: [统御]：相邻友方单位受到的伤害-{r}。
cards.flavor: 地底下的根，早就把大家缝在一起了。

art.subject: a hunched old woman kneeling with her hands in the earth, glowing roots spreading from her fingers beneath the feet of nearby spirits

cards.name: 盘根庭
cards.text: 阵地。友方单位受到的伤害-{r}。具有[坚守]的友方单位+{a}攻击。

upgrade.text: 阵地。友方单位受到的伤害-{r}。具有[坚守]的友方单位+{a}攻击，并在你的回合开始时恢复{h}点生命。

cards.flavor: 庭中古木的根在地下握成一只拳。

art.subject: an ancient courtyard where colossal tree roots have broken through the flagstones and interlocked into a fortress wall, lantern light between the roots

cards.name: 轮回古榕
cards.text:
每当另一个友方单位死亡，获得+{a}/+{a}。
[遗志]：召唤一个「榕种」（其[遗志]会召唤「轮回古榕」）。

upgrade.text:
[起势]：召唤一个「榕种」。
每当另一个友方单位死亡，获得+{a}/+{a}。
[遗志]：召唤一个「榕种」（其[遗志]会召唤「轮回古榕」）。

cards.flavor: 榕树的气根落地，便又是一棵榕树。它从来没有真正死过。

art.subject: a vast banyan tree whose hanging aerial roots take root and become new trunks in a ring around it, a seed glowing at the center of the ring, dusk light

cards.name: 荚灵
cards.text: [遗志]：召唤{n}个「灵苗」。

upgrade.text:
[坚守]。
[遗志]：召唤{n}个「灵苗」。

cards.flavor: 荚一裂，满地都是新面孔。

art.subject: a plump bean-pod creature with stubby legs, its seam glowing as tiny sapling spirits peek out from inside, standing on a mossy root

cards.name: 走根
cards.text: 将一个友方单位移至另一排，使其获得+{a}/+{a}。抽{n}张牌。

upgrade.text:
[藏锋]。
将一个友方单位移至另一排，使其获得+{a}/+{a}。抽{n}张牌。

cards.flavor: 树不会走？那是你没见过它们在夜里换位置。

art.subject: a young tree spirit pulling its roots out of the soil and striding to a new spot, soil clods falling, moonlit clearing with other trees watching

cards.name: 苔鹿
cards.text: [滋长]{g}

upgrade.text: [坚守]。[滋长]{g}

cards.flavor: 它在山鬼身后走了三百年，角上的苔越长越厚。

art.subject: a gentle stag whose antlers are overgrown with moss and tiny ferns, standing in a misty mountain glade, amber light on its flank

cards.name: 播灵
cards.text:
召唤{n}个「灵苗」。
[献]：召唤{m}个「灵苗」。
cards.flavor: 撒下去的不是种子，是名字。

art.subject: a slender hand scattering glowing seeds over dark soil, each seed sprouting a tiny luminous sapling spirit with leaf-shaped eyes

cards.name: 灵鼓
cards.text: 所有友方单位本回合获得+{a}攻击。抽{n}张牌。
cards.flavor: 鼓面是一段空心的老桑，一敲，满林子都醒了。

art.subject: a hollow mulberry trunk drum struck by a vine mallet, rings of green firefly light pulsing outward over a crowd of small forest spirits

cards.name: 枯荣
cards.text: 消灭一个友方单位。抽{n}张牌，随机一个友方单位获得+{a}/+{a}。
cards.flavor: 一岁一枯荣。枯的那一半，也是它自己。

art.subject: a withered sapling crumbling to ash on one side while fresh green shoots burst from the same roots on the other, split light and shadow

cards.name: 魂归
cards.text: [应]：消灭一个友方单位。主帅获得{a}点[护甲]，外加等于该单位生命值的[护甲]。
cards.flavor: 落叶归根，归的是护着根的那一层。

art.subject: a small tree spirit dissolving into a stream of glowing leaves that wrap around a commander as a layered bark cloak, dusk forest

cards.name: 百灵姥
cards.text: 每当一个友方单位入场（包括此单位），使其获得+{a}/+{a}。

upgrade.text: 每当一个友方单位入场（包括此单位），使其获得+{a}/+{a}与[疾行]。

cards.flavor: 林子里每一个新生的，都先被她抱一抱。

art.subject: a serene grandmother figure seated in the hollow of a giant tree, cradling a newborn sapling spirit while dozens of tiny spirits climb over her mossy shawl

cards.name: 春播
cards.text:
[延时]{t}，挂在一个友方角色身上。
[判定]：召唤{n}个「灵苗」；{moon}月纹——额外召唤{m}个。
cards.flavor: 种下去，等一场月光。

art.subject: a farmer spirit pressing seeds into moonlit furrows, a crescent moon reflected in a paddy of water behind, faint sprouts already glowing in the rows

cards.name: 群灵出巢
cards.text: 召唤{n}个「灵苗」。
cards.flavor: 一声口哨，满山的树洞都开了门。

art.subject: dozens of tiny glowing sapling spirits pouring out of hollows in an old tree trunk, tumbling over each other toward the viewer, spores in the air

cards.name: 群灵扑击
cards.text: 造成{d}点伤害。每有一个友方单位，伤害+{k}。
cards.flavor: 一只不可怕。一林子才可怕。

art.subject: a swarm of small leafy forest spirits leaping together onto a hulking armored foe, vines and petals flying, dynamic diagonal composition

cards.name: 棘背山猪
cards.text: [棘刺]{t}
cards.flavor: 撞上去之前，先想想它背上长的是什么。

art.subject: a stocky wild boar whose back bristles are thick bramble thorns, head lowered and tusks forward, stamping on forest mud

cards.name: 千岁松
cards.flavor: 一千年里，它只学会了一件事：再高一点。

art.subject: a colossal ancient pine rooted on a cliff edge, its twisted trunk forming a stern guardian face, clouds wrapping its crown, low sun behind

cards.name: 万木争春
cards.text: 所有友方单位获得+{a}/+{a}。若你拥有至少{m}个友方单位，抽{n}张牌。
cards.flavor: 春风一过，谁都不肯落后半寸。

art.subject: an entire forest of young trees and spirits surging upward at once under a wave of warm spring wind, blossoms and leaves spiraling into the sky

cards.name: 结藤娘
cards.text: [起势]：召唤一个具有[坚守]的「藤甲傀」。

upgrade.text:
[起势]：召唤一个具有[坚守]的「藤甲傀」。
[遗志]：召唤一个「藤甲傀」。

cards.flavor: 她编的傀儡不会说话，只会挡在前头。

art.subject: a young woman in green robes weaving thick vines with quick fingers, a half-finished vine guardian rising beside her, fireflies around her hands

cards.name: 青藤杖
cards.text: 武器（攻击{w}，距离{r}，耐久{u}）。主帅每次攻击时，召唤{n}个「灵苗」。
cards.flavor: 杖头每点一下，地里就冒出一个脑袋。

art.subject: a gnarled staff wrapped in living green vines, its tip blooming with a glowing bud, planted in soil as tiny sprouts rise in a circle around its base

cards.name: 藤甲
cards.text: [应]：召唤{n}个具有[坚守]的「藤甲傀」。
cards.flavor: 刀落下来之前，藤先立起来。

art.subject: vines erupting from the ground and braiding themselves into a shield-bearing guardian in front of a startled spirit, a blade descending from above

cards.name: 哭柳
cards.text: 每当另一个友方单位死亡，随机对一个敌人造成{d}点伤害。
cards.flavor: 柳枝垂到地上，是为了把死去的都记下来。

art.subject: a willow tree spirit with a sorrowful woman's face in its bark, long drooping branches ending in sharp glinting leaves that lash outward

cards.name: 枯木逢春
cards.text: 从弃牌堆选择{n}张单位牌加入手牌。召唤{m}个「灵苗」。
cards.flavor: 死去的那棵，根还醒着。

art.subject: a blackened dead stump with a single bright green shoot bursting from its center, spring rain falling, soft light breaking through clouds

cards.name: 榕种
cards.text: [遗志]：召唤一个「轮回古榕」。
cards.flavor: 它等着被打碎。

art.subject: a large seed pod with a cracked shell, golden light and thin aerial roots spilling from the crack, resting in a nest of old banyan roots

cards.name: 蛊虫
cards.text: [遗志]：随机一个敌人获得{p}层[中毒]。
cards.flavor: 死了也要咬一口。

art.subject: a jade-green centipede-like insect with leaf-shaped carapace plates, rearing up with dripping luminous venom on its mandibles

cards.name: 蛊瓮
cards.text: 召唤{n}个「蛊虫」。[燃尽]
cards.flavor: 封口的红布一揭，瓮里便窸窸窣窣。

art.subject: a small clay jar sealed with red cloth, the cloth lifting as green-glowing insects crawl out of the opening, dim lantern light

cards.name: 山魅
cards.text: [滋长]{g}
cards.flavor: 借了一副旧形骸，便又是一条命。

art.subject: a translucent mountain spirit wearing a mask of bark and a cloak of hanging moss, crouched on a rocky ledge, pale green wisps trailing from its limbs

cards.name: 灵苗
cards.flavor: 刚学会站起来，就学会了往前冲。

art.subject: a tiny glowing sapling spirit with two leaf ears and round dark eyes, standing bravely on a moss stone, spores drifting around it

cards.name: 藤甲傀
cards.text: [坚守]
cards.flavor: 空壳，却站得比谁都直。

art.subject: a hollow humanoid figure woven from thick braided vines, arms crossed in a guarding stance, faint green light glowing inside its chest

cards.name: 厄运
cards.text: 无法打出。抽到此牌时，将一张{r}点{mountain}山纹命牌置于天命牌堆顶。
cards.flavor: 翻开的每一张命牌，都是那座压在你头上的山。

art.subject: a single dull gray fate card marked with a small mountain sigil sliding onto the top of a glowing card stack, a crow perched on the stack watching

cards.name: 悔恨
cards.text: 无法打出。回合结束时若在手中，失去等同于你手牌数的生命。
cards.flavor: 攥得越紧，越疼。

art.subject: a figure kneeling in the rain clutching a bundle of wilted letters to the chest, knuckles white, faces of the past faint in the puddles

cards.name: 枷锁
cards.text: 无法打出。回合结束时若在手中，获得{w}层[虚弱]。[献]：将一张枷锁洗入你的抽牌堆。
cards.flavor: 献出去的是锁，回来的还是锁。

art.subject: a heavy wooden cangue collar with iron chains lying in a dungeon, the chains glowing faintly and slithering back toward an unseen prisoner

cards.name: 离魂
cards.text: 无法打出。抽到此牌时，失去{n}点生命。
cards.flavor: 有一瞬间，你从背后看见了自己。

art.subject: a pale translucent soul drifting half out of a sleeping traveler's body, tethered by a thinning silver thread, cold moonlight through a window

cards.name: 命殇
cards.text: [藏锋]。无法打出。在手中时，每进行一次[判定]，失去{n}点生命。
cards.flavor: 天意每显一次，你身上的裂痕就深一分。

art.subject: a torn fate card bleeding thin red light from its tear, hovering over an outstretched hand whose skin cracks like porcelain in the same pattern

cards.name: 宿业
cards.text: [本命]。无法打出。回合结束时若在手中，失去{n}点生命。[献]：失去{m}点生命。
cards.flavor: 逆命者每走一步，命书便在背后多记一笔。

art.subject: a heavy black ink chain of written characters coiling out of an open ancient book and winding around a traveler's ankle, faint red glow in the strokes

cards.name: 贪念
cards.text: [藏锋]。无法打出。在手中时，每当你献出其他牌，失去{n}点生命。
cards.flavor: 它不许你放下任何东西——除了它自己。

art.subject: a hand clenched around a heap of gold coins that are turning into grasping little claws, digging into the palm, dim candlelight

cards.name: 心魔
cards.text: 无法打出。回合结束时若在手中，获得{v}层[易伤]。
cards.flavor: 它长着你的脸，说着你不敢说的话。

art.subject: a meditating warrior with a dark smoky double of themselves rising from their shadow, the double grinning and whispering into their ear

cards.name: 渊视
cards.text: [观星]{n}，然后你获得{m}枚[命签]。
cards.flavor: 湖底有一面镜子，照得见明天。

art.subject: a huge pale eye opening at the bottom of a dark lake, fate cards drifting upward past it like fallen leaves

cards.name: 无字判
cards.text: [判定]：阳纹——对敌方主帅造成{d}点伤害；阴纹——你的主帅获得{a}点[护甲]。
cards.flavor: 无字之碑，判起人来最公平——谁都没有名字。

art.subject: a towering blank stone tablet splitting a falling fate card in half with a crack of pale light, a lone figure recoiling below

cards.name: 刻名
cards.text: [延时]{t}：[判定]：阴纹——目标受到{d}点伤害。
cards.flavor: 碑上无字，便刻你的。

art.subject: a spectral chisel hovering over a blank tombstone, carving a glowing name stroke by stroke while grey dust drifts down in moonlight

cards.name: 魅惑
cards.text: 施加{w}层[虚弱]与{v}层[易伤]。
cards.flavor: “你叫什么名字？”——千万别回答。

art.subject: a beautiful woman's face half-hidden behind a silk fan, fox ears faintly visible in shadow, her gaze pulling a thread of light from a warrior's chest

cards.name: 珊瑚甲
cards.text: 装备（防具）：你的回合开始时，你的主帅获得{a}点[护甲]。
cards.flavor: 珊瑚一年长一分，这副甲长了三百年。

art.subject: an ornate suit of armor grown from red and white coral branches standing on a sunken dais, small fish drifting through its gaps

cards.name: 军法
cards.text: [延时]{t}：[判定]：点数不大于{k}——目标受到{d}点伤害。
cards.flavor: 军中无戏言，点数小者斩。

art.subject: a rusted executioner's command token hanging over a kneeling silhouette, a fate card flipping in the air beside it, harsh torchlight

cards.name: 记过
cards.text: [延时]{t}：[判定]：点数不大于{k}——目标受到{d}点伤害并获得{w}层[虚弱]。
cards.flavor: 过记三笔，就该去堂上走一趟了。

art.subject: a ghostly clerk inking a mark into a damp ledger by a green lantern, a faint chain of light reaching from the page to a distant figure

cards.name: 溺拽
cards.text: 造成{d}点伤害；若目标处于[冰冻]，再造成{d}点伤害。
cards.flavor: 冻住的人最好拽，连挣扎都省了。

art.subject: a bloated drowned hand bursting from icy water to seize a frozen warrior's ankle, cracks spreading across the ice

cards.name: 抹字
cards.text: 造成{d}点伤害；若目标身上有[延时]牌，改为造成{e}点伤害。
cards.flavor: 刻上去的名字，也最容易抹掉。

art.subject: a grey stone thumb smearing a glowing inscription off a tomb face, the light tearing loose like smoke and striking a distant figure

cards.name: 水漫金殿
cards.text: 阵地，持续{t}回合：敌方角色受到的伤害+{a}。
cards.flavor: 金殿沉了三百年，水从未退过。

art.subject: a golden throne hall flooding with green lake water pouring through shattered windows, floating banners and drifting lanterns

cards.name: 狐火
cards.text: 造成{d}点伤害，施加{b}层[灼烧]。
cards.flavor: 青色的火，烧的不是皮肉，是记忆。

art.subject: a swirl of pale blue fox-fire orbs spiraling around a startled traveler at night, reflections dancing on wet gravestones

cards.name: 狐契
cards.text: [延时]{t}：[判定]：{moon}月纹——目标失去{d}点生命；{mountain}山纹——目标获得{w}层[虚弱]与{w}层[易伤]。
cards.flavor: 契约写在月下，签名的是你的影子。

art.subject: a paper contract sealed with a fox paw print floating under a crescent moon, its edges curling into blue flame

cards.name: 机关弩台
cards.text: [远射]。你的回合开始时：对敌方主帅造成{d}点伤害。
cards.flavor: 它不需要人拉弦，只需要一个目标。

art.subject: a clockwork crossbow turret of lacquered wood and brass gears on spider-like legs, a bolt ready to fire, gears glinting in lamplight

cards.name: 机关木墙
cards.text: 召唤{n}面机关木墙（[坚守]，[棘刺]{th}）。
cards.flavor: 墙上的钉子都朝外，一根也没朝里。

art.subject: a folding wall of interlocking wooden panels bristling with iron spikes, unfolding itself across a flooded corridor

cards.name: 泼墨
cards.text: 造成{d}点伤害，施加{w}层[虚弱]。
cards.flavor: 一团墨，便是一个人的一生被涂去。

art.subject: a splash of black ink shaped like a grasping hand bursting across the air toward a warrior, droplets frozen mid-flight in dim light

cards.name: 铁雨
cards.text: 对所有敌方角色造成{d}点伤害。
cards.flavor: 三百年前射出的箭，今天才落地。

art.subject: a dense volley of rusted arrows arcing down from a storm-dark sky onto a battle line, shields raised, sparks where iron meets iron

cards.name: 生死簿
cards.text: [延时]{t}：[判定]：点数{lo}至{hi}——目标失去{d}点生命；阴纹——目标获得{w}层[虚弱]。
cards.flavor: 簿上有你的名字，旁边还空着一格。

art.subject: an ancient ledger bound in black leather lying open on a judge's desk, a vermilion brush poised above a name as candlelight gutters

cards.name: 镜花
cards.text: 你的主帅获得{w}层[灵障]并恢复{h}点生命。
cards.flavor: 你砍中的，只是镜中花。

art.subject: a translucent flower of mirror shards blooming in front of a pale woman, a sword strike shattering harmlessly against its petals

cards.name: 月书
cards.text: [观星]{n}，你的主帅获得{a}点[护甲]。
cards.flavor: 月光照在碑上，字便换了次序。

art.subject: three fate cards floating in a column of cold moonlight above a stone tablet, slowly rotating as a veiled hand rearranges them

cards.name: 点兵
cards.text: 召唤{n}名锈甲亲兵。
cards.flavor: “到！”——坟里有人应了一声。

art.subject: a rusted armored soldier clawing up out of a grave mound, raising his shield toward a commander's banner in grey morning fog

cards.name: 噬名宴
cards.text: 对敌方主帅造成{d}点伤害，你的主帅恢复等同于其失去生命值的生命。
cards.flavor: 名字入口即化，回味是那人的一生。

art.subject: a fox spirit inhaling a ribbon of glowing written characters drawn out of a kneeling warrior's mouth, lantern light flickering

cards.name: 千针雨
cards.text: 对所有敌方角色造成{d}点伤害。
cards.flavor: 机括一响，满殿都是针。

art.subject: hundreds of steel needles bursting from hidden slots in a lacquered wall, streaking across a dim hall like silver rain

cards.name: 贡珠
cards.text: 你的主帅恢复{h}点生命并获得{r}层[再生]。
cards.flavor: 溺死的臣子仍在进贡，贡品是自己的眼泪。

art.subject: a kneeling drowned courtier offering a tray of luminous pearls upward, the pearls glowing softly in murky blue water

cards.name: 朱笔勾魂
cards.text: 若目标敌方单位生命值不高于{n}，将其消灭；否则对其造成{d}点伤害。
cards.flavor: 一勾，一个名字；一点，一条命。

art.subject: a giant vermilion brush sweeping a single red stroke through the air, the stroke cutting through a soldier who dissolves into ink

cards.name: 锈戟
cards.text: 装备（武器，耐久{n}）：你的主帅攻击伤害+{a}。
cards.flavor: 锈得越厉害，砍进去越难拔出来。

art.subject: a massive rust-eaten halberd planted upright in a battlefield of broken shields, flakes of rust drifting in a dull orange dusk

cards.name: 列盾
cards.text: 你方所有角色获得{a}点[护甲]。
cards.flavor: 盾挨着盾，死人挨着死人。

art.subject: a row of undead soldiers locking rust-pitted shields into a wall, bracing together under a hail of light, dust kicked up at their feet

cards.name: 牵丝
cards.text: 你方所有单位获得+{a}攻击力与{b}点[护甲]。
cards.flavor: 丝一紧，木头也会咬牙。

art.subject: glinting silver threads descending from darkness into the joints of several wooden puppets, jerking them into combat stances

cards.name: 备件
cards.text: 召唤{n}具木傀，你方所有单位恢复{h}点生命。
cards.flavor: 手断了换手，头断了换头。

art.subject: a workbench heaped with wooden limbs and heads, silk threads snapping them together into a new puppet that rises from the pile

cards.name: 立碑
cards.text: 召唤{n}座无字碑。
cards.flavor: 石头不会退，也不会疼。

art.subject: a squat stone guardian statue with a cracked blank face planted among gravestones, moss on its shoulders, cold fog behind it

cards.name: 三尾卜
cards.text: [判定]：阳纹——召唤{n}只狐影；阴纹——你的主帅恢复{h}点生命。
cards.flavor: 三条尾巴各指一方，狐母只信最坏的那条。

art.subject: three glowing fox tails fanning out behind a crouching fox spirit, each tail tip touching a floating fate card in a moonlit clearing

cards.name: 潮鼓
cards.text: 阵地，持续{t}回合：你方的攻击伤害+{a}。
cards.flavor: 湖底擂鼓，湖面起浪。

art.subject: a colossal barnacle-crusted drum on the lakebed struck by drowned soldiers, shockwaves rippling upward through green water

cards.name: 潮痕
cards.text: [延时]{t}：[判定]：阴纹——目标受到{d}点伤害并获得{f}层[冰冻]。
cards.flavor: 水涨到哪里，命就淹到哪里。

art.subject: a dark waterline creeping up a warrior's armor, frost blooming where it touches, murky water rising in a drowned palace hall

cards.name: 暗流
cards.text: 对一个敌方单位造成{d}点伤害并施加{f}层[冰冻]，然后将其移至后排。
cards.flavor: 湖面平静，湖底有手。

art.subject: a swirling black current dragging a soldier backward through waist-deep water, pale hands visible beneath the surface

cards.name: 催阵鼓
cards.text: 阵地，持续{t}回合：你方单位攻击力+{a}。
cards.flavor: 鼓皮早就烂了，鼓声却一直在响。

art.subject: a tattered war drum on a skeletal frame beating by itself in a misty graveyard, ghostly soldiers stirring in rows behind it

cards.name: 阳判令
cards.text: [判定]：阳纹——你方所有角色恢复{h}点生命；阴纹——你方所有角色获得{a}点[护甲]。
cards.flavor: 阳司的令牌是暖的，暖得像一场骗局。

art.subject: a gilded command token engraved with a sun rising above a judge's bench, radiating warm light over kneeling spectral clerks

cards.name: 阴判令
cards.text: [判定]：阳纹——造成{d}点伤害并施加{v}层[易伤]；阴纹——你获得{n}枚[命签]。
cards.flavor: 阴司的令牌是冷的，冷得烫手。

art.subject: a black iron command token engraved with a crescent, thrown from the shadows and trailing violet sparks toward a startled figure

cards.name: 灰羽
cards.text: 己方主帅获得{a}点[护甲]，并清除其所有减益。
cards.flavor: 烧过的羽毛，不怕再烧一次。

art.subject: great wings of grey ash folding around a burning core, flakes drifting away, the fire inside calm and protected

cards.name: 缝命线
cards.text: [延时]{t}：[判定]：阴纹——受到{d}点伤害并[眩晕]；阳纹——获得{w}层[虚弱]。
cards.flavor: 一针一线，把你缝进书里。

art.subject: a glowing golden needle trailing thread, stitching a struggling silhouette into the spine of a giant book

cards.name: 黑日
cards.text: 持续{t}回合：敌方角色受到的治疗-{h}，获得[护甲]时-{a}。
cards.flavor: 天狗吞日，万物无影，亦无暖。

art.subject: a black sun ringed by a thin white corona hanging over a darkened landscape, cold grey light and no shadows anywhere

cards.name: 涂改
cards.text: 将一个敌方单位涂改为{a}/{h}的墨团。
cards.flavor: 写错了，涂掉便是。

art.subject: a giant brush stroke of black ink smearing over a painted warrior on a scroll, the figure dissolving into a shapeless blot

cards.name: 墨卫听令
cards.text: 召唤{n}名墨卫。
cards.flavor: 命书的脊骨，也是它的门。

art.subject: the spine of a colossal book splitting open as a tall ink sentinel steps out, gripping an iron binding awl, golden thread trailing from its shoulders

cards.name: 卷宗
cards.text: 收{n}张[命签]，己方主帅获得{a}点[护甲]。
cards.flavor: 每一桩旧案，都压着一张命牌。

art.subject: a thick bound case file falling open on a desk, a single glowing fate card slipping out from between its pages

cards.name: 执念
cards.text: 对敌方主帅造成{d}点伤害，己方主帅恢复等同于其因此失去的生命。
cards.flavor: 抓住了，就不放。

art.subject: an ink-black hand clamping around a glowing thread of life, drawing its light back into a shadowy wrist

cards.name: 合卷
cards.text: 将{n}张恍惚置入敌方手牌。
cards.flavor: 书一合上，便什么也看不清了。

art.subject: two massive book covers slamming shut, a burst of loose pages and dust exploding outward from between them

cards.name: 日冕
cards.text: 持续{t}回合：敌方角色受到的[灼烧]伤害+{x}；己方回合开始时，对敌方主帅施加{b}层[灼烧]。
cards.flavor: 太阳的外衣，比太阳更烫。

art.subject: a vast ring of solar corona filling the sky above a scorched hall, flaring tendrils of plasma licking down toward the floor

cards.name: 晨兆
cards.text: [判定]：{sun}日纹——对敌方主帅造成{d}点伤害；{thunder}雷纹——对敌方主帅施加{b}层[灼烧]；阴纹——己方主帅获得{a}点[护甲]。
cards.flavor: 天未亮，命已定。

art.subject: a fate card flipping in midair against a blood-orange dawn, its face showing a blazing sun sigil, rays fanning out behind it

cards.name: 暗堂
cards.text: 持续{t}回合：友方角色受到的伤害-{r}。
cards.flavor: 灯下最暗。

art.subject: a vast dim temple hall lit only by rows of tiny lamps, shadows pooling thick between pillars, a hush over everything

cards.name: 回响
cards.text: 造成{d}点伤害；敌方场上每有一个单位，伤害+{e}。
cards.flavor: 你带来的人越多，回声越响。

art.subject: a single strike echoing outward as a series of fading afterimages, each echo landing harder than the last

cards.name: 蚀月爪
cards.text: 造成{d}点伤害。若目标有[虚弱]，再造成{d}点伤害。
cards.flavor: 月缺一角，便是它的爪印。

art.subject: a huge shadowy claw raking across a full moon, leaving three dark gashes as moonlight bleeds from the wounds

cards.name: 长明灯
cards.text: 召唤{n}盏长明灯。
cards.flavor: 灯不灭，人不亡。

art.subject: a tall bronze temple lamp standing alone, its flame steady and golden, a halo of warm light pushing back the surrounding darkness

cards.name: 命笔
cards.text: 造成{d}点伤害，收{n}张[命签]。
cards.flavor: 笔尖所指，即是命数。

art.subject: a brush of pure starlight flicking a single stroke through the air, the stroke hardening into a glowing fate card

cards.name: 定数
cards.text: 己方主帅获得{a}点[护甲]；若本回合已进行过[判定]，改为获得{b}点。
cards.flavor: 已翻开的牌，便是定数。

art.subject: a fate card pinned to a stone tablet by a golden brush, radiating a steady protective light

cards.name: 飞白
cards.text: 造成{d}点伤害{n}次。
cards.flavor: 笔枯而势不断。

art.subject: a dry-brush calligraphy stroke whipping through the air in two streaks, white gaps in the ink flashing like blades

cards.name: 金羽
cards.text: 造成{d}点伤害，施加{b}层[灼烧]。
cards.flavor: 一根羽毛，便是一寸烈日。

art.subject: a single golden feather streaking down like a meteor, trailing fire, about to pierce the ground

cards.name: 天命诏
cards.text: [延时]{t}：[判定]：点数≤{lo}——受到{d}点伤害并获得{w}层[虚弱]；点数≥{hi}——受到{e}点伤害。
cards.flavor: 天命有常，不为你存，不为你亡。

art.subject: a colossal scroll descending from a starry void, sealed with a glowing celestial seal, its shadow falling over a tiny figure below

cards.name: 空我
cards.text: 己方主帅获得等同于敌方主帅[护甲]+{a}点的[护甲]。
cards.flavor: 你的甲，也是它的甲。

art.subject: a hollow suit of armor assembling itself piece by piece out of reflected light, empty inside

cards.name: 肃静
cards.text: 己方主帅获得{a}点[护甲]，对敌方主帅施加{w}层[虚弱]。
cards.flavor: 堂上无声，唯闻落笔。

art.subject: a lacquered gavel block striking a stone bench, a shockwave of silence rippling outward and dimming every lantern in the hall

cards.name: 洗砚
cards.text: 己方回合开始时，己方主帅获得{a}点[护甲]。
cards.flavor: 砚是先生留下的，洗了三百年，墨痕还在。

art.subject: an ancient carved inkstone with a pool of dark water, a faint star reflected in it, resting on a scholar's desk

cards.name: 添油
cards.text: 为一个友方角色恢复{h}点生命，并施加{r}层[再生]。
cards.flavor: 油是灯的血。

art.subject: a thin stream of glowing golden oil pouring from a long spout into a flickering lamp, the flame swelling bright

cards.name: 灯罩
cards.text: 所有友方角色获得{n}层[灵障]。
cards.flavor: 薄纱一层，风雨不侵。

art.subject: translucent paper lamp shades unfolding around a group of figures, each glowing like a protective lantern bubble

cards.name: 末行
cards.text: 造成{d}点伤害，己方每有一张[命签]，伤害+{e}。
cards.flavor: 最后一行，他写了三百年也没写完。

art.subject: the final line of an enormous book glowing white-hot, the characters lifting off the page and lancing forward as beams of starlight

cards.name: 镜片
cards.text: 己方主帅获得{m}层[锋锐]，再获得等同于敌方主帅[锋锐]层数的[锋锐]。
cards.flavor: 镜子里的刀，和你的一样快。

art.subject: a jagged shard of mirror reflecting a raised blade, the reflection's blade glinting sharper than the original

cards.name: 月蚀
cards.text: [延时]{t}：[判定]：阴纹——受到{d}点伤害并获得{v}层[易伤]；阳纹——受到{e}点伤害。
cards.flavor: 月亮一寸一寸被咬去，你也是。

art.subject: a crescent of shadow slowly creeping over a pale moon above a lone figure, whose own shadow is being devoured at the same pace

cards.name: 旧愿
cards.text: [延时]{t}：[判定]：阴纹——受到{d}点伤害，并将{n}张伤口置入敌方弃牌堆；阳纹——受到{e}点伤害。
cards.flavor: 当年许下的愿，如今来讨债了。

art.subject: a faded paper wish-lantern drifting back down from the night sky, its old handwriting now glowing an angry red

cards.name: 朱圈
cards.text: [延时]{t}：[判定]：点数≥{hi}——受到{e}点伤害；点数≤{lo}——受到{d}点伤害，并将{n}张伤口置入敌方弃牌堆。
cards.flavor: 名字上画了圈，便是勾了。

art.subject: a bold vermilion circle drawn around a single name in a ledger of fates, the ink still wet and glistening

cards.name: 悔
cards.text: 将{n}张伤口洗入敌方牌库。
cards.flavor: 每一个“如果当初”，都是一道新伤。

art.subject: old scars glowing faintly on an outstretched palm, each scar shaped like a half-remembered moment

cards.name: 改命
cards.text: [观星]{n}，然后将{m}张点数为{r}的{mountain}山纹牌置于天命牌堆顶。
cards.flavor: 他改过千万人的命，从不留痕。

art.subject: long elegant fingers rearranging a fan of glowing fate cards, placing a heavy stone-grey card on top of the deck

cards.name: 炙烤
cards.text: 施加{b}层[灼烧]。
cards.flavor: 无处可躲的正午。

art.subject: a figure caught in a column of blinding sunlight, heat haze warping the air, the ground cracking beneath their feet

cards.name: 乱笔
cards.text: 将{n}张恍惚洗入敌方牌库。
cards.flavor: 童子的字，连先生也认不出。

art.subject: wild scribbled brush strokes spiraling across a stack of pages, making the characters swim and blur

cards.name: 星诏
cards.text: [延时]{t}：[判定]：阴纹——受到{d}点伤害；阳纹——受到{e}点伤害。
cards.flavor: 诏书自星上来，不容辩驳。

art.subject: a golden imperial edict scroll unrolling in midair, its characters made of burning stars, hovering ominously over a kneeling silhouette

cards.name: 星墨
cards.text: 对所有敌方角色造成{d}点伤害，并施加{w}层[虚弱]。
cards.flavor: 以星为墨，一滴便是一夜。

art.subject: a splash of ink full of tiny stars spreading across the battlefield like a night sky spilled from a jar

cards.name: 无星夜
cards.text: [观星]{n}，收{s}张[命签]。
cards.flavor: 星都被吃光的夜里，只有它看得清命牌。

art.subject: a completely starless night sky with a single pair of glowing eyes studying a spread of fate cards floating in the dark

cards.name: 停时
cards.text: 持续{t}回合：敌方每回合少抽{n}张牌，[余烬]上限-{e}。
cards.flavor: 命书之心，时间停在装订线上。

art.subject: falling grains of sand frozen in midair above a cracked hourglass, drifting pages and embers suspended motionless around it

cards.name: 传唤
cards.text: 召唤{n}名殿前力士。
cards.flavor: “带上来。”

art.subject: a heavy court door bursting open as a burly talisman-faced guard strides through, staff in hand, torchlight behind him

cards.name: 吞光
cards.text: 对敌方主帅施加{w}层[虚弱]，己方主帅恢复{h}点生命。
cards.flavor: 光被咽下去时，是温的。

art.subject: a dark maw inhaling streams of lantern light from the room, the lamps guttering out one by one

cards.name: 天狗吠
cards.text: 召唤{n}只天狗崽，所有友方单位获得{m}层[锋锐]。
cards.flavor: 一犬吠形，百犬吠声。

art.subject: a great shadow hound howling at an eclipsed sky while smaller black pups scramble out of the darkness at its feet

cards.name: 更漏
cards.text: [延时]{t}：[判定]：阴纹——受到{d}点伤害并获得{v}层[易伤]；阳纹——受到{e}点伤害。
cards.flavor: 漏尽钟鸣，命数到头。

art.subject: a bronze water clock dripping its last drop, a phantom bell ringing above it, rings of sound closing around a small figure

cards.name: 三足踏
cards.text: 对所有敌方前阵单位造成{d}点伤害，并施加{b}层[灼烧]。
cards.flavor: 三足落地，地皮焦了三层。

art.subject: three enormous flaming bird talons slamming down in a row, shockwaves of fire rolling outward across a stone floor

cards.name: 翻页
cards.text: 召唤{n}只墨精。
cards.flavor: 翻过一页，墨点便跳了出来。

art.subject: a page of a huge book being turned, tiny ink imps tumbling out from the fold and scampering across the paper

cards.name: 不放
cards.text: 对攻击力最高的敌方单位施加{f}层[冰冻]与{w}层[虚弱]。
cards.flavor: 最锋利的那把刀，被握得最紧。

art.subject: ink-black fingers wrapping tightly around a warrior's raised sword arm, frost spreading from the grip

cards.name: 朱批
cards.text: 造成{d}点伤害，施加{w}层[虚弱]。
cards.flavor: 朱笔一落，便是铁案。

art.subject: a vermilion brush slashing a bold red mark across a judgment scroll, droplets of red ink flying like sparks under lantern light

cards.name: 灯花爆
cards.text: 对所有敌方角色造成{d}点伤害，并施加{b}层[灼烧]。
cards.flavor: 灯花一爆，喜事将近——对灯而言。

art.subject: a lamp wick bursting into a blossom of sparks that scatter outward across a dark hall like burning petals

cards.name: 归墟炉
cards.text: 你每回合可以额外献出{k}张牌。每当你献出一张牌，对一个随机敌人造成{d}点伤害。

upgrade.text: [本命]。你每回合可以额外献出{k}张牌。每当你献出一张牌，对一个随机敌人造成{d}点伤害。

cards.flavor: 万物落进去，只剩一缕白烟，和一粒还在发烫的源。

art.subject: a colossal bronze furnace sunk into a bottomless chasm, cards and relics spiraling down into its white-hot mouth, pale smoke rising in a single column

cards.name: 百川归流
cards.text: 你的[源]中每有一种颜色（素色不计），抽{n}张牌。
cards.flavor: 赤水、玄水、青水，流到海里都是一个颜色。

art.subject: several rivers of different tinted waters, red, deep blue and green, braiding together through a valley and pouring into one luminous sea at dusk

cards.name: 横刀格挡
cards.text: [应]：获得{a}点[护甲]。

upgrade.text: [应]：获得{a}点[护甲]。若在应对窗口中打出，抽{n}张牌。

cards.flavor: 刀背迎上去的那一刻，你已经在想下一招。

art.subject: a fighter catching a heavy downward blow on a horizontally raised saber, sparks bursting at the point of contact, knees bent, rain streaking the dark

cards.name: 掷钱问卦
cards.text: [判定]：阳纹——对目标造成{d}点伤害；阴纹——获得{a}点[护甲]。
cards.flavor: 三枚铜钱落地，字面朝天者进，背面朝天者守。

art.subject: three bronze square-holed coins spinning in midair above an open palm, one landing face up on a cracked tile floor, lantern light glinting off their rims

cards.name: 地脉灵泉
cards.text: 获得{n}枚素[源]。[燃尽]。

upgrade.text: 获得{n}枚素[源]与{m}枚你主帅颜色的[源]。[燃尽]。

cards.flavor: 凿开一寸岩层，涌出来的是三百年前的雨。

art.subject: a pick striking a cracked rock face and releasing a gush of luminous white spring water, droplets hanging in the air like pearls, cave darkness around

cards.name: 五色符
cards.text: 选择一种颜色，本回合获得{n}枚该色的临时[源]。[燃尽]。

upgrade.text: 选择一种颜色，本回合获得{n}枚该色的临时[源]。

cards.flavor: 一张黄纸，五道朱砂。写哪一道，全看你缺哪一口气。

art.subject: a paper talisman held between two fingers, five brush strokes glowing in vermilion, indigo, jade, gold and violet, embers peeling from its edges

cards.name: 五行散人

cards.flavor: 关早就破了，他还守着那道门槛。

upgrade.text: [观星]{p}。抽{n}张牌。

cards.flavor: 天幕裂开一道缝，缝里是明天的颜色。

cards.flavor: 刀还在半空，挨刀的人已经换了。

cards.flavor: 他只认得两种东西：风向，和猎物。

cards.name: 蛭巫
cards.text: [汲命]。
cards.flavor: 沼泽里的老妪，放一次血，还你一口气。

cards.name: 野市

art.subject: a crowded night market in a ruined courtyard lit by paper lanterns, stalls of mysterious goods, hooded figures bargaining, mist drifting between the awnings

cards.name: 夜行客
cards.text: [奇袭]。

upgrade.text: [奇袭]。[隐匿]。

cards.flavor: 墙再高，也高不过檐下的影子。

art.subject: a masked night runner in dark wrappings leaping between tiled rooftops under a thin crescent moon, twin short knives reversed along the forearms

cards.flavor: 每一块补丁，都是一张献出去的牌换来的。

upgrade.text: [起势]：从三张你流派的随机牌中选择一张加入手牌，它已升级。

cards.flavor: “客官，赤的玄的都有，看您今天是什么命。”

cards.name: 素玉璧

upgrade.text: 每回合你第一次献牌时，抽{n}张牌，并获得{e}枚临时[源]。

cards.flavor: 无纹无饰的玉，什么都盛得下。

cards.name: 素心供

cards.flavor: 灯芯挑一挑，还能再亮一更。

cards.name: 游方剑客

cards.flavor: 剑比人先到，人比名声先走。

art.subject: a wandering swordsman in a travel-worn straw hat mid-dash, blade half drawn from its scabbard, dust kicking up on a dirt road, low sun

cards.name: 翻检行囊

cards.name: 挪移阵脚

cards.flavor: 阵不在人多，在脚下那一步。

cards.name: 扎草人

cards.name: 双刀客
cards.text: [连斩]。
cards.flavor: 左手问路，右手答话。

cards.flavor: 他念的经没人听得懂，但刀砍上去是真的会停。

art.subject: a bald warrior monk holding prayer beads up in one hand, a translucent golden bell-shaped barrier ringing around him and a figure behind him

cards.name: 蚀毒
cards.text: 无法打出。回合结束时若在手中，获得{n}层[中毒]。

cards.text: 无法打出。
cards.flavor: 不致命，只是碍事。

cards.text: [坚守]。

upgrade.text: 弃置所有手牌，每弃置一张，抽{n}张牌。

art.subject: a brute's heavy saber twisting back toward its own wielder, guided by a thin violet silk thread held by an unseen hand, sparks

cards.text: [起势]：抽{n}张牌，然后弃置{m}张牌。

cards.flavor: 万蛊之母，从不亲自动口。

cards.text: [延时]1。[判定]：阳纹——造成{d}点伤害；阴纹——施加{p}层[中毒]。

cards.flavor: 灯熄着，棋子还在盘上。

art.subject: a dim study with a go board frozen mid-game, a hooded player sitting completely still in shadow, a single lamp turned low

cards.text: [远射]。[起势]：弃置所有手牌，每弃置一张，抽{n}张牌。每当你弃置一张牌，对一名随机敌人造成{d}点伤害。

art.subject: a gaunt ghostly go player in rotted scholar robes sitting cross-legged beside a mossy stone board, a rusted axe handle crumbling nearby, pale violet spirit light

cards.name: 叠刃
cards.text: 造成{d}点伤害；本回合你每已打出一张牌，伤害+{e}。
cards.flavor: 一刀叠一刀，最后那刀最重。

art.subject: multiple translucent violet blade arcs stacked in the air converging on one point, a swordswoman at the end of the sequence, dark background

cards.name: 瘴雾
cards.text: 对所有敌人施加{p}层[中毒]。[献]：对所有敌人施加{s}层[中毒]。

art.subject: a thick green-violet fog rolling over a marsh battlefield, silhouettes of soldiers coughing and stumbling, sickly sunlight above

cards.name: 镜花水月

art.subject: a warrior slashing at a reflection of a woman in a still pond, the blade instead cutting his own ally standing beside him, moon overhead

cards.name: 万蛊噬心
cards.text: 对每个敌人造成等同于其[中毒]层数{m}倍的伤害（无视[护甲]与[灵障]）。[燃尽]

cards.name: 千针
cards.text: 对随机敌人造成{d}点伤害，共{b}次；本回合你每已打出一张牌，额外重复一次。

art.subject: a storm of fine silver needles raining diagonally across a courtyard at night, a lone figure in violet at the center with arms spread

art.subject: a swarm of glowing violet insects bursting from one fallen soldier and streaming toward the rest of an enemy line, green haze, dusk

cards.name: 毒蛾
cards.text: [远射]。此单位造成伤害后，对受伤者施加{p}层[中毒]。
cards.flavor: 翅上的粉，比刀还记仇。

art.subject: a large moth with dusky violet wings patterned like eyes, shedding glowing green scales as it hovers, dark forest clearing

cards.name: 千机匣

upgrade.text: 你的回合开始时，将{n}张[浮光]的「影针+」加入手牌。

cards.text: [隐匿]。[献]：将一张[浮光]的「影针」加入手牌。

cards.flavor: 它从不走门。

cards.name: 影舞者

cards.text: 我方回合开始时：若你装备着武器，武器攻击力+{a}、耐久+{u}；否则装备一把赤铜环刀。
cards.flavor: 他的炉子烧的是一小块落下来的太阳，所以从不熄。

art.subject: a burly blacksmith with a leather apron hammering a glowing blade on an anvil beside a furnace containing a miniature sun, sparks raining, half body

cards.name: 随锋剑侍
cards.text: 主帅攻击后，此单位也攻击同一目标。

upgrade.text: [远射]。主帅攻击后，此单位也攻击同一目标。

cards.flavor: 将军的刀往哪里落，她的剑就往哪里去，从不迟半拍。

art.subject: a young swordswoman in red and black following just behind a larger armored figure, both striking in the same direction, mirrored poses

cards.name: 焚阳前锋
cards.text:
[疾行]。
[献]：对随机敌人造成{d}点伤害。

upgrade.text:
[疾行]。[连斩]。
[献]：对随机敌人造成{d}点伤害。

cards.flavor: 冲在最前面的人，从不回头看有没有人跟上。

art.subject: a lean soldier in red scale armor sprinting forward with a curved saber held low, a trail of embers behind, dynamic full body

cards.name: 朱雀·焚羽
cards.text:
[远射]。此单位在场时，你每回合可多献牌{s}次；每当你献出一张牌，对所有敌人造成{d}点伤害。
[遗志]：若本场你已献出至少{n}张牌，将一张朱雀·焚羽置入手牌。

upgrade.text:
[远射]。此单位在场时，你每回合可多献牌{s}次；每当你献出一张牌，对所有敌人造成{d}点伤害。
[遗志]：将一张升级过的朱雀·焚羽置入手牌。

cards.flavor: 南方之神不死，只是一次次把自己交给火。

art.subject: a magnificent vermilion phoenix with long trailing flame plumes rising from a pyre, wings fully spread, radiant light bursting behind it

cards.name: 野火
cards.text: 对所有敌人施加{b}层[灼烧]。
cards.flavor: 野火不认得敌我，所以焚阳宗只在风向对时放它。

art.subject: a wall of wildfire sweeping across a dry plain toward a line of shadowy figures, a lone figure in red standing upwind with arm outstretched

cards.name: 断焰刀
cards.text: 武器：攻击力{w}，距离{r}，耐久{u}。
cards.flavor: 刀身齐腰而断，断口至今不冷。

art.subject: a broken-tipped broadsword lying on scorched stone, the sheared edge glowing molten orange, thin smoke curling from it

cards.name: 火种
cards.text:
对随机敌人施加{b}层[灼烧]。[燃尽]。
[献]：抽{n}张牌。
cards.flavor: 借一点火去，还一片光来。

art.subject: a single ember cupped in two open palms, glowing brightly in darkness, tiny sparks lifting from it

cards.name: 月苗
cards.flavor: 只在月纹翻开的那一刻破土。

art.subject: a tiny luminous sprout with crescent-shaped leaves pushing out of dark soil under pale moonlight

cards.name: 残卦
cards.text: [浮光]。[延时]{t}：[判定]：{sun}{thunder}阳纹——造成{d}点伤害；{moon}{mountain}阴纹——施加{w}层[虚弱]与{v}层[易伤]。
cards.flavor: 没算完的卦，也会自己找上门。

art.subject: half of a burnt divination tortoise shell floating in the dark, glowing cracks spreading across it like lightning

cards.name: 护命符
cards.text: 挂载时，被挂载者获得{a}点[护甲]。[延时]{t}：[判定]：{sun}{thunder}阳纹——被挂载者获得{g}层[灵障]；{moon}{mountain}阴纹——被挂载者恢复{h}点生命。
cards.flavor: 符纸会烧完，但烧完之前，谁也动不了你。

art.subject: a golden amulet on a red cord hanging around the neck of a wounded soldier, emitting a soft protective halo

cards.name: 浑天星盘
cards.text: 你的判定点数+{r}。[命签]上限+{s}。我方回合开始时，若你没有[命签]，收取{n}张[命签]。
cards.flavor: 星盘转一圈，就是人间的一年。

art.subject: a floating golden armillary sphere with nested rotating rings studded with tiny stars, hovering beside a commander’s shoulder

cards.name: 布卦师
cards.text: [起势]：对一个随机敌人挂载一张[延时]牌「残卦」。

upgrade.text: [起势]：对随机敌人挂载两张[延时]牌「残卦」（可能是同一个敌人）。

cards.flavor: 他布下的卦，比他本人先到。

art.subject: a masked diviner kneeling on a stone floor, flinging burning tortoise shell fragments that curve through the air toward distant enemies

cards.name: 星幕
cards.text: 获得{a}点[护甲]。
cards.flavor: 把夜空披在身上，刀剑也要迷路。

art.subject: a robed figure raising one sleeve as a translucent curtain of constellations unfurls in front of them, faint golden light on the fabric

cards.name: 星芒
cards.text: 造成{d}点伤害。
cards.flavor: 星光落在刃上，便不再是光。

art.subject: a young astrologer in gilded robes thrusting a slim bronze gnomon like a spear, a thin beam of starlight streaking from its tip across a dark sky

cards.name: 日曜当空
cards.text: 造成{d}点伤害。本回合每出现过一次{sun}日纹判定，额外造成{e}点伤害。
cards.flavor: 日头越毒，这一剑越亮。

art.subject: a swordswoman raising a blade straight up toward a blazing noon sun, the sunlight pooling along the edge until it drips like molten gold

cards.name: 司辰铜镜
cards.text: 每当你[改判]后，抽{c}张牌。

upgrade.text: 每当你[改判]后，抽{c}张牌并获得{a}点[护甲]。

cards.flavor: 镜里照出的，永远是下一刻的你。

art.subject: an ornate round bronze mirror on a stand, its surface showing a slightly different version of the room with a card being swapped in a hand

cards.name: 掷筮
cards.text: [判定]：{sun}{thunder}阳纹——造成{d}点伤害；{moon}{mountain}阴纹——造成{e}点伤害并抽{c}张牌。
cards.flavor: 蓍草五十根，用四十九。剩下那一根，是留给变数的。

art.subject: a bundle of yarrow stalks scattering across a lacquered table, one stalk flying off and turning into a golden bolt aimed at a monster

cards.name: 周天星斗
cards.text: [天契]{sun}：对一个随机敌人造成{d}点伤害。[天契]{thunder}：对所有敌人造成{e}点伤害。[天契]{moon}：抽{c}张牌。[天契]{mountain}：获得{a}点[护甲]。
cards.flavor: 周天三百六十五度，每一度都站着一颗星，每一颗星都听他的。

art.subject: a vast circular star map glowing on the ground of a battlefield, four quadrants burning with sun, lightning, moon and mountain light

cards.name: 连环卦
cards.text: [延时]{t}：[判定]：{sun}{thunder}阳纹——造成{d}点伤害；{moon}{mountain}阴纹——造成{e}点伤害，并对其挂载一张「残卦」。
cards.flavor: 一卦不应，便再起一卦。他有的是耐心。

art.subject: a chain of interlocking bronze hexagram plates coiling around a beast, one plate cracking open to reveal another beneath

cards.name: 铜钱卦师
cards.text: [天契]{sun}：对一个随机敌人造成{d}点伤害。[天契]{mountain}：你的主帅获得{a}点[护甲]。
cards.flavor: 正面是日，背面是山，他从不押中间。

art.subject: a lean street diviner in patched robes flicking a large bronze coin high into the air with his thumb, sun and mountain glyphs glinting on its faces

cards.name: 蚀月咒
cards.text: [延时]{t}：[判定]：{sun}{thunder}阳纹——造成{d}点伤害；{moon}{mountain}阴纹——施加{v}层[易伤]与{w}层[虚弱]。
cards.flavor: 月亮缺的那一块，被咒进了你的骨头里。

art.subject: a dark crescent moon being eaten by shadow above a hunched warrior, cold silver light draining out of his armor

cards.name: 星陨
cards.text: [延时]{t}：[判定]：点数1–5——造成{a}点伤害；点数6–10——造成{b}点伤害；点数11–13——造成{c}点伤害，再对所有敌人造成{s}点伤害。
cards.flavor: 它从命书的边缘掉下来，砸在谁头上，全凭点数。

art.subject: a burning meteor with a numbered golden tail plunging toward an enemy camp, the ground below already glowing

cards.name: 悬命鬼差
cards.text: [起势]：对每个敌人各挂载一张[延时]牌「残卦」。

upgrade.text: [坚守]。[起势]：对每个敌人各挂载一张[延时]牌「残卦」。

cards.flavor: 他腰间的铃铛一响，名册上就多一行字。

art.subject: a gaunt underworld bailiff in black and white robes holding a ledger and a brush, glowing talismans flying out from the ledger toward several enemies

cards.name: 太卜令
cards.text: [远射]。[起势]：收取{n}张[命签]。你的判定点数+{r}。每当你[改判]后，对所有敌人造成{d}点伤害。

upgrade.text: [远射]、[灵障]。[起势]：收取{n}张[命签]。你的判定点数+{r}。每当你[改判]后，对所有敌人造成{d}点伤害。

cards.flavor: “天命？我替天子读了四十年天命。它每一次都在等我点头。”

art.subject: an imposing elderly grand diviner in layered gold and black court robes, seated before a floating ring of fortune slips, one hand raised as lightning gathers above

cards.name: 量天卦尺
cards.text: 武器：攻击力{w}，距离{r}，耐久{u}。主帅每次攻击后，[观星]{s}。
cards.flavor: 尺上刻的不是寸，是卦；量得出天有多高，也敲得碎人的额头。

art.subject: a long bronze divination ruler engraved with trigram marks and star charts, glowing faintly gold, held edge-on like a blade against a night sky full of constellations

cards.name: 悬星
cards.text: [延时]{t}：[判定]：{sun}{thunder}阳纹——造成{d}点伤害；{moon}{mountain}阴纹——造成{e}点伤害。
cards.flavor: 那颗星一直挂在他头顶。他抬头的那天，它落了。

art.subject: a single sharp star hanging by a golden thread above the head of an unaware ogre, the thread fraying

cards.name: 天罗
cards.text: [延时]{t}：[判定]：{sun}{thunder}阳纹——造成{d}点伤害；{moon}{mountain}阴纹——造成{e}点伤害并施加{f}层[冰冻]。
cards.flavor: 网是早就织好的，只等天色一暗。

art.subject: an enormous net of golden star-threads slowly lowering from the night sky over a battlefield, a giant beast looking up too late

cards.name: 天谴
cards.text: [应]：[判定]：{sun}{thunder}阳纹——对宣告行动的敌人造成{d}点伤害并使其[眩晕]；{moon}{mountain}阴纹——对其造成{e}点伤害，你获得{a}点[护甲]。
cards.flavor: 你抬手的时候，天也抬了手。

art.subject: an enemy warrior mid-lunge being struck from above by a giant hand of golden light emerging from the clouds

cards.name: 天命难违
cards.text: [延时]{t}：[判定]：{sun}{thunder}阳纹——造成{d}点伤害；{moon}{mountain}阴纹——造成{e}点伤害并使其[眩晕]。
cards.flavor: 写下的那一刻就已经发生了。剩下的三天，只是让你慢慢明白。

art.subject: a colossal brush of starlight writing a single burning character in the sky above a giant demon king, who stares upward as the ink begins to drip down toward him

cards.name: 月下侍书
cards.text: [起势]：将{n}张点数为{r}的{moon}月纹牌洗入天命牌堆。[天契]{moon}：抽{c}张牌。
cards.flavor: 她只在月下抄书。白天抄的字，第二天都会不见。

art.subject: a quiet scribe girl kneeling at a low desk under a full moon, copying glowing characters that drift up off the page like fireflies

cards.name: 镇山符
cards.text: 获得{a}点[护甲]。将{n}张点数为{r}的{mountain}山纹牌洗入天命牌堆。
cards.flavor: 把山写进命里，命就不容易动了。

art.subject: a heavy stone talisman carved with a mountain glyph slamming into the ground before a guardian, rock ridges rising up like a wall

cards.name: 万象归一
cards.text: 对所有敌人造成{d}点伤害；每个敌人身上每有1张[延时]牌，便额外受到{e}点伤害。
cards.flavor: 所有悬着的卦，在这一刻同时落地。

art.subject: dozens of hovering hexagram talismans over a battlefield collapsing inward at once, each one bursting into a pillar of golden light on the enemies below

cards.name: 九宫锁
cards.text: [延时]{t}：[判定]：{sun}{thunder}阳纹——使其[眩晕]并造成{d}点伤害；{moon}{mountain}阴纹——施加{f}层[冰冻]与{w}层[虚弱]。
cards.flavor: 九宫一合，连时间都走不出去。

art.subject: a glowing three-by-three grid of golden sigils snapping shut around a massive armored enemy like a cage, frost and sparks at the seams

cards.name: 九星断
cards.text: [判定]：点数1–4——造成{a}点伤害并收取{n}张[命签]；点数5–9——造成{b}点伤害；点数10–13——造成{c}点伤害并抽{m}张牌。
cards.flavor: 九颗星排成一列，一颗比一颗亮，一颗比一颗凶。

art.subject: nine stars descending in a vertical line of increasing brightness toward a kneeling warlord, the last one blinding white

cards.name: 观星台
cards.text: 我方回合开始时，[观星]{n}。你的判定点数+{r}。
cards.flavor: 台高九丈，离天近了，命也就近了。

art.subject: a tall tiered stone observatory tower under a sky thick with stars, armillary spheres turning on its top terrace, golden lanterns along the stairs

cards.name: 一念天机
cards.text: [观星]{X}，然后进行{X}次[判定]：{sun}{thunder}阳纹——对一个随机敌人造成{d}点伤害；{moon}{mountain}阴纹——获得{a}点[护甲]。

upgrade.text: [观星]{X}+1，然后进行{X}+1次[判定]：{sun}{thunder}阳纹——对一个随机敌人造成{d}点伤害；{moon}{mountain}阴纹——获得{a}点[护甲]。

cards.flavor: 天机不在星上，在看星的人一念之间。

art.subject: a lone figure standing at the center of a spiral of hundreds of floating fate cards, eyes closed, the cards flipping face up one after another in a wave of golden light

cards.name: 拈签
cards.text: 收取{n}张[命签]。获得{a}点[护甲]。
cards.flavor: 签在手里，命就还没落地。

art.subject: a young woman in a temple courtyard shaking a bronze cylinder until one glowing slip jumps out, a shimmering shield of light forming behind her

cards.name: 点星
cards.text: [判定]：{sun}{thunder}阳纹——造成等于判定牌点数的伤害；{moon}{mountain}阴纹——获得等于判定牌点数的[护甲]。

upgrade.text: [判定]：{sun}{thunder}阳纹——造成等于判定牌点数+{b}的伤害；{moon}{mountain}阴纹——获得等于判定牌点数+{b}的[护甲]。

cards.flavor: 天上有几颗星，这一击就有几分力。

art.subject: a fingertip touching a star in the night sky, the star flaring and dropping straight down as a spear of numbered golden light

cards.name: 收命
cards.text: [应]：收取{n}张[命签]，[观星]{m}，获得{a}点[护甲]。

upgrade.text: [藏锋]。[应]：收取{n}张[命签]，[观星]{m}，获得{a}点[护甲]。

cards.flavor: 敌人出手的那一瞬，命书翻得最快。

art.subject: a hand snatching a glowing card out of a swirling stream of fate cards mid-battle, while an enemy blade is frozen mid-swing

cards.name: 移星换位
cards.text: [应]：[判定]：{sun}{thunder}阳纹——取消该行动；{moon}{mountain}阴纹——获得{a}点[护甲]并收取{n}张[命签]。
cards.flavor: 敌人的刀没有变慢，只是那一刻的星位变了。

art.subject: an astrologer sweeping his sleeve across the sky, two constellations swapping places while an enemy strike freezes and scatters into light

cards.name: 执签客
cards.text: [起势]：收取{n}张[命签]。每当你[改判]后，对一个随机敌人造成{d}点伤害。

upgrade.text: [远射]。[起势]：收取{n}张[命签]。每当你[改判]后，对一个随机敌人造成{d}点伤害。

cards.flavor: 他替人换命，按张收钱。换下来的那张，他会亲手送到仇家门口。

art.subject: a tall swordsman in a wide straw hat holding a fan of glowing fortune slips between his fingers, one slip turning into a thrown blade

cards.name: 观星童子
cards.flavor: 师父说，数星星数到第一千颗，就能看见命书的边。

art.subject: a small child in oversized golden astronomer robes standing on tiptoe on a rooftop, pointing a tiny brass telescope at a swirl of stars

cards.name: 夜观星象
cards.text: [观星]{n}。抽{c}张牌。

upgrade.text: [本命]。[观星]{n}。抽{c}张牌。

cards.flavor: 星子不会说谎，只会换个顺序。

art.subject: an astrologer lying on the roof of a pagoda at night, hands framing a cluster of stars as if rearranging them, the stars trailing faint lines between his fingers

cards.name: 星遁
cards.text: [应]：[判定]：{sun}{thunder}阳纹——获得{a}点[护甲]；{moon}{mountain}阴纹——获得{b}点[护甲]并收取{n}张[命签]。
cards.flavor: 刀落下时，他站在昨夜的星位上。

art.subject: a blade slicing through a figure that dissolves into a scatter of golden star points, reforming a step to the side

cards.name: 引日
cards.text: 造成{d}点伤害。将{n}张点数为{r}的{sun}日纹牌洗入天命牌堆。

upgrade.text: 造成{d}点伤害。将一张点数为{r}的{sun}日纹牌置于天命牌堆顶，再将一张洗入天命牌堆。

cards.flavor: 命书第一卷，写满了征伐。多抄几页，也无人察觉。

art.subject: a priest raising a bronze mirror to catch the rising sun, a blazing disc of light splitting off and slamming into an enemy while glowing cards scatter around

cards.name: 雷部行者
cards.text: [起势]：将{n}张点数为{r}的{thunder}雷纹牌洗入天命牌堆。[天契]{thunder}：对所有敌人造成{d}点伤害。

upgrade.text: [疾行]。[起势]：将{n}张点数为{r}的{thunder}雷纹牌洗入天命牌堆。[天契]{thunder}：对所有敌人造成{d}点伤害。

cards.flavor: 雷部的差役，腰里别着一卷写满罪名的命书。

art.subject: a wiry messenger with drum-shaped lightning rings on his back sprinting forward, violet lightning crackling from his heels

cards.name: 雷霆判词
cards.text: [判定]：{thunder}雷纹——造成{d}点伤害并使其[眩晕]；{sun}日纹——造成{d}点伤害；{moon}{mountain}阴纹——造成{e}点伤害并获得{a}点[护甲]。
cards.flavor: 判词只有一个字，由天来念。

art.subject: a massive column of violet lightning striking down onto a demon from a scroll unrolled across the storm clouds

cards.name: 催命符
cards.text: 造成{d}点伤害。若目标身上有[延时]牌，施加{v}层[易伤]。
cards.flavor: 卦已经挂上了，差的只是一声催。

art.subject: a crimson-ink talisman slapped onto the back of a monster already wrapped in glowing hexagram chains, the chains tightening

cards.name: 天衡
cards.text: [判定]：{sun}{thunder}阳纹——造成{d}点伤害；{moon}{mountain}阴纹——获得{a}点[护甲]并抽{c}张牌。
cards.flavor: 天平两端，一端是剑，一端是盾。司天监只负责看清砝码。

art.subject: an old court astronomer holding a golden balance scale whose two pans glow with a sun sigil and a crescent moon sigil, night observatory behind him

cards.name: 截命签
cards.text: 收取{n}张[命签]。抽{c}张牌。

upgrade.text: [藏锋]。收取{n}张[命签]。抽{c}张牌。

cards.flavor: 命书翻到这一页之前，先把它折个角。

art.subject: long elegant fingers plucking a single glowing bamboo fortune slip out of a bronze cylinder filled with slips, golden dust rising

cards.name: 量天尺
cards.text: [判定]：点数≥8——造成{d}点伤害；点数≤7——造成{e}点伤害并收取{n}张[命签]。
cards.flavor: 天有多高，尺子就有多长；尺子有多长，就能量出多重的罪。

art.subject: a long jade measuring rod engraved with star marks swinging down in an arc, leaving a trail of numbered golden notches in the air

cards.name: 落卦钱
cards.text: 造成{d}点伤害。目标身上每有1张[延时]牌，额外造成{e}点伤害。
cards.flavor: 三枚铜钱落地，卦就成了。剩下的只是时间。

art.subject: three square-holed bronze coins spinning through the air toward a shadowy foe, each trailing a thin golden thread tied to hanging talismans

cards.name: 卦煞
cards.text: [延时]{t}：[判定]：{sun}{thunder}阳纹——造成{d}点伤害；{moon}{mountain}阴纹——造成{e}点伤害并施加{w}层[虚弱]。
cards.flavor: “今夜别出门。”他收了钱，没说为什么。

art.subject: a hexagram of six broken and unbroken ink bars hovering over a hunched demon, faintly crackling with golden sparks before it falls

cards.name: 避凶符
cards.text: 挂载时，被挂载者获得{a}点[护甲]。[延时]{t}：[判定]：{sun}{thunder}阳纹——抽{c}张牌；{moon}{mountain}阴纹——被挂载者获得{b}点[护甲]。
cards.flavor: 趋吉容易，避凶难。他只卖难的那种。

art.subject: a yellow paper talisman with red brush strokes pinned to the shoulder of a soldier, a faint golden dome forming around him

relics.name: 司命朱笔
relics.text: 每回合开始时，获得1枚本回合的[源]。所有敌人攻击力+1。
relics.flavor: 朱笔一勾，你多得一分，天下也多恨你一分。

art.subject: a long calligraphy brush with a vermilion-soaked tip, dripping red ink that glows like blood, over a floating open ledger

relics.name: 沉渊王印
relics.text: 每回合开始时，获得1枚本回合的[源]。你无法在营地休息恢复生命。
relics.flavor: 溺王殷的印。拿着它的人，再也睡不安稳。

art.subject: a heavy jade royal seal covered in barnacles and dripping black water, a drowned dragon carved on top, eerie green glow

relics.name: 金乌之影
relics.text: 所有角色的[灼烧]不再衰减。战斗开始时，对所有敌人施加4层[灼烧]，对你的主帅施加2层[灼烧]。
relics.flavor: 三足金乌落下的影子，连执命者也一并烧着。

art.subject: the black silhouette of a three-legged crow cast across burning ground, its shadow itself made of flickering flames

relics.name: 残烛金灯
relics.text: 每回合开始时，获得1枚本回合的[源]。每回合少抽1张牌。
relics.flavor: 灯油只够照亮手边，照不到远处。

art.subject: an ornate golden oil lamp with a single guttering flame, bright at the wick but darkness closing in around it

relics.name: 母树之种
relics.text: 每当友方单位入场，使其获得[滋长]1。拾取时，最大生命-10。
relics.flavor: 种下它的人，要把自己的一部分也埋进土里。

art.subject: a huge glowing seed cracked open with a tiny world tree sprouting from it, roots curling around a drop of blood

relics.name: 镇岳山心
relics.text: 你的[应]牌费用-1。[余烬]上限+2。你的[源]上限-3。
relics.flavor: 山心不动，所以山外的一切都来得及。

art.subject: a glowing blue crystal heart embedded inside a split boulder, slow pulses of light rippling through the stone

relics.name: 噬名狐尾
relics.text: 每回合开始时，获得1枚本回合的[源]。你的主帅受到的伤害+1。
relics.flavor: 狐母吃掉的名字都在尾巴里。它们会在你受伤时一起叫出声。

art.subject: a single luxurious silver fox tail with faint ghostly faces shimmering within its fur, coiled on a dark altar

relics.name: 执笔童子墨
relics.text: [命签]上限+2。每回合开始时，获得1张[命签]。每回合少抽1张牌。
relics.flavor: 童子研的墨，写什么都会成真——只是写得很慢。

art.subject: a small ink stick shaped like a sleeping child scribe, grinding in an ink stone that reflects a sky full of stars

relics.name: 千机匣
relics.text: 回合结束时，你不再弃置手牌。手牌上限-3。
relics.flavor: 千机傀儡师的匣子。放进去的东西，一件也拿不出来。

art.subject: an intricate puppeteer's lacquered box with dozens of tiny drawers and gears, silk strings trailing from it, violet light

relics.name: 裂命之书
relics.text: 战斗开始时，获得2枚主帅主色的[源]。每回合可献牌为源的次数-1（通常即不能献牌）。
relics.flavor: 撕下两页换来的力量，再也不能用别的东西去换。

art.subject: a thick ancient book split down the spine, two pages torn out and burning into glowing orbs of colored light

relics.name: 玄铁甲片
relics.text: 回合开始时，我方每个角色至多保留8点[护甲]，不再全部清零。
relics.flavor: 镇岳门的甲片，一片压一片，像山的年轮。

art.subject: a single overlapping dark iron armor scale engraved with mountain patterns, frost on its edge, cold blue light

relics.name: 骨笛
relics.text: 每当一个敌方单位死亡，抽1张牌。
relics.flavor: 吹响它的不是风，是刚散的魂。

art.subject: a pale bone flute with seven holes, a wisp of ghostly blue smoke drifting out of it, lying on black silk

relics.name: 断弦琴轸
relics.text: 每打出6张牌，抽2张牌。
relics.flavor: 弦断了，轸还在拧。拧满六圈，便有一声余响。

art.subject: a carved rosewood tuning peg of an old zither with a snapped silk string wound around it, lying on dark lacquered wood

relics.name: 铜铃
relics.text: 每回合你第一次在敌方回合打出[应]牌时，抽1张牌。
relics.flavor: 铃响在刀落之前。

art.subject: a small bronze wind bell with a jade clapper swaying on a red string, motion blur, sharp wind

relics.name: 赤铜刀镡
relics.text: 你的主帅攻击距离+1（需装备武器）。
relics.flavor: 护手宽一分，刀就长一寸。

art.subject: an ornate red-bronze sword guard shaped like coiled flames, resting on a whetstone, warm forge light

relics.name: 晨钟碎片
relics.text: 战斗开始时，抽2张牌。
relics.flavor: 钟碎了，敲它还是会醒。

art.subject: a curved shard of a bronze temple bell with engraved clouds, lit by pale dawn light through fog

relics.name: 余烬炉
relics.text: [余烬]上限+1。
relics.flavor: 炉灰里总埋着一点红，留给夜里的人。

art.subject: a small three-legged bronze brazier filled with grey ash, a few glowing red embers buried inside, night darkness

relics.name: 幽弈坊骰子
relics.text: 每回合你打出第3张牌时，对随机敌人施加3层[中毒]。
relics.flavor: 坊里的骰子只有一面是空的。你永远掷不到它。

art.subject: a violet bone die with green venom dripping from its pips, rolling across a dark gambling table in candlelight

relics.name: 碑前冷酒
relics.text: 战斗胜利后，恢复6点生命。
relics.flavor: 敬亡者一杯，自己也喝一杯。

art.subject: a small cracked clay wine jar and cup placed before a weathered gravestone, cold mist, a single paper lantern

relics.name: 采药篓
relics.text: 拾取时，获得2瓶随机丹药。
relics.flavor: 采药人没有回来，篓子却一直在路边等着。

art.subject: a woven bamboo herb basket overflowing with glowing mushrooms and roots, abandoned beside a mossy stone path

relics.name: 墨斗线
relics.text: 每当你献牌为源，获得3点[护甲]。
relics.flavor: 木匠弹一道墨线，梁就正了；你献一张牌，命就稳了。

art.subject: a carpenter's ink line reel shaped like a small wooden boat, a taut black ink-soaked thread stretched across a beam

relics.name: 长生木牌
relics.text: 拾取时，最大生命+10。
relics.flavor: 牌上写着一个陌生人的名字，和一个很长的寿数。

art.subject: an old wooden memorial tablet painted with faded red characters, tied with a green ribbon, soft candlelight

relics.name: 残页·月卷
relics.text: 每当你方的[判定]结果为{moon}月纹，抽1张牌。
relics.flavor: 月卷记归藏。读它的人，总会多想起一件事。

art.subject: a torn silver-edged scroll page drifting in darkness, a pale crescent moon sigil shining on it, faint mist around

relics.name: 残页·山卷
relics.text: 每当你方的[判定]结果为{mountain}山纹，获得4点[护甲]。
relics.flavor: 山卷记长久。它比别的残页都重。

art.subject: a heavy torn scroll page resting on a stone ledge, a green triangular mountain sigil etched into it, dust motes in soft light

relics.name: 残页·日卷
relics.text: 每当你方的[判定]结果为{sun}日纹，对随机敌人造成3点伤害。
relics.flavor: 日卷记征伐。纸边焦黑，仍烫手。

art.subject: a torn scorched page of an ancient scroll floating in the air, a golden sun sigil glowing on it, embers curling from its burnt edge

relics.name: 残页·雷卷
relics.text: 每当你方的[判定]结果为{thunder}雷纹，对所有敌人造成2点伤害。
relics.flavor: 雷卷记天罚。撕下它时，天上响了一声。

art.subject: a torn violet scroll page crackling with small lightning arcs, a thunderbolt sigil at its center, storm clouds behind

relics.name: 纸人替身
relics.text: 战斗开始时，获得1层[灵障]。
relics.flavor: 它替你挨第一下。它从不抱怨。

art.subject: a small white paper effigy of a person with a red talisman stamp on its chest, standing upright on a table, faint glow

relics.name: 丹囊
relics.text: 丹药栏位+1。
relics.flavor: 多一个口袋，就多一条命。

art.subject: an embroidered cloth pouch with several small porcelain pill bottles peeking out, tied with a red cord

relics.name: 锈铁护心镜
relics.text: 每场战斗的第一回合开始时，获得8点[护甲]。
relics.flavor: 锈甲将军的旧部，把它挂在碑上，等一个还会冲锋的人。

art.subject: a round rusted iron breastplate mirror hanging from a leather cord, dented at the center, reflecting cold light

relics.name: 引魂灯芯
relics.text: 每回合第一次有友方单位死亡时，抽1张牌。
relics.flavor: 万木庭的灯芯是草籽捻成的。灯灭了，种子就落地。

art.subject: a twisted lamp wick made of green grass seeds burning with a soft jade flame, tiny seeds falling from it

relics.name: 观星阁铜签
relics.text: 战斗开始时，获得1张[命签]。
relics.flavor: 阁中弟子人手一支。抽中什么，便信什么。

art.subject: a thin gilded bronze divination lot engraved with star charts, standing in a bamboo cup, golden starlight above

relics.name: 断碑拓片
relics.text: 每场战斗一次：受到伤害后若生命低于最大生命的一半，恢复12点生命。
relics.flavor: 拓下来的是一个人的生辰。贴在胸口，就还能多活一会儿。

art.subject: a paper rubbing of a broken stele with faint black ink characters, fluttering in wind, pinned by a small stone

relics.name: 焚阳火镰
relics.text: 战斗开始时，对所有敌人施加3层[灼烧]。
relics.flavor: 焚阳宗入门第一课：先学会怎样点着别人。

art.subject: a curved steel fire striker with a crimson tassel striking sparks off a flint, bright orange sparks flying

relics.name: 破庙蒲团
relics.text: 在营地休息时，额外恢复10点生命。
relics.flavor: 庙塌了一半，蒲团还是暖的。

art.subject: a worn round straw meditation cushion in a half-collapsed temple, moonlight through the broken roof

relics.name: 地宫铜钱串
relics.text: 战斗胜利后，额外获得10金。
relics.flavor: 地下王国的钱，在地上也还算钱。

art.subject: a string of green-patinated square-holed bronze coins coiled on a stone floor, faint torchlight glinting

relics.name: 司命遗墨
relics.text: 拾取时，向天命牌堆加入2张{sun}日纹13与2张{mountain}山纹13。
relics.flavor: 司命写错的几笔，被你偷偷描了回去。

art.subject: a dried pool of luminous gold ink on an ancient desk, four fresh cards painted from it, a brush left mid-stroke

relics.name: 逆命之契
relics.text: 每回合可以额外献牌为源1次。每当你献牌为源，失去2点生命。
relics.flavor: 契约上写着：多给你一次，也多收你一次。

art.subject: a scroll contract signed in blood with a burning thumbprint, dark red wax seal cracking open, smoke curling

relics.name: 溺王的金冠
relics.text: 你的主帅造成的攻击伤害+2。每回合开始时，失去1点生命。
relics.flavor: 冠很重。戴着它的人，每天都在往下沉一点。

art.subject: a tall golden king's crown half sunk in black water, water streaming from its jewels, reflection distorted

relics.name: 狐母的绒球
relics.text: 战斗开始时，获得4层[再生]。
relics.flavor: 她给你的时候笑得很温柔。你最好别问是谁的毛。

art.subject: a soft round ball of white fox fur tied with a red bell string, faintly glowing warm pink, on a mossy stone

relics.name: 守墓人的铁铲
relics.text: 每当一个敌方单位死亡，战斗后额外获得3金。
relics.flavor: 埋人的活，总得有人收钱。

art.subject: a worn iron grave spade planted in fresh earth beside a leaning tombstone, a few coins glinting in the dirt

relics.name: 残页·星卷
relics.text: 每场战斗你第一次打出延时牌时，立即进行一次[判定]：阳纹——对随机敌人造成8点伤害；阴纹——获得8点[护甲]。
relics.flavor: 星卷不写命数，只写命数来临之前的那一瞬。

art.subject: a torn scroll page covered in tiny dotted constellations, one star flaring bright as it falls off the page

relics.name: 王庭钥匙
relics.text: 拾取时，获得1件随机稀有遗物，并将1张「宿业」加入牌组。
relics.flavor: 地下王庭的宝库只有一扇门，门后还站着看守的东西。

art.subject: a large ornate bronze key with a crown-shaped bow, a faint dark aura clinging to its teeth, on a velvet cushion

relics.name: 双生判官的铜钱
relics.text: 每当你[改判]，对随机敌人造成5点伤害。
relics.flavor: 正面判生，反面判死。它从来只落在侧面。

art.subject: an old bronze coin spinning on its edge, one face with a smiling judge and the other a frowning judge, dim courtroom

relics.name: 不周山石
relics.text: 你的主帅受到的伤害-1。
relics.flavor: 撑过天的石头，挡一刀不算什么。

art.subject: a fist-sized fragment of a broken celestial pillar, dense grey stone veined with faint starlight, resting on silk

relics.name: 溺王珠冠
relics.text: 战斗开始时，对所有敌人施加2层[虚弱]和2层[易伤]。
relics.flavor: 戴上它，敌人会看见城沉下去的那一夜。

art.subject: a waterlogged royal pearl crown dripping water, strands of pearls tangled with river weed, dark green depths

relics.name: 回音石磬
relics.text: 每回合你第一次在敌方回合打出[应]牌后，重置1枚已用的[源]（可继续作为[余烬]使用）。
relics.flavor: 敲一下，响两声。第二声是留给自己的。

art.subject: an L-shaped black stone chime hanging from a wooden frame, visible sound ripples echoing twice around it

relics.name: 命书残页·终卷
relics.text: 每回合你打出的第一张牌费用-1。
relics.flavor: 终卷只有一句：先落笔者，定其势。

art.subject: the last torn page of a celestial book, blank except for a single brush stroke glowing gold, floating above an ink stone

relics.name: 金乌衔日
relics.text: 战斗开始时，将一张{sun}日纹13置于天命牌堆顶（仅本场战斗）。
relics.flavor: 第一缕光，是它叼来的。

art.subject: a small three-legged golden crow carved in gold, holding a blazing sun disc in its beak, radiant rays

relics.name: 天机星盘
relics.text: 你的延时牌费用-1。每当你打出延时牌，[观星]2。
relics.flavor: 它不预言何时发生，只安排发生的次序。

art.subject: an intricate golden armillary sphere with rotating rings of stars, a tiny comet orbiting inside, deep night sky

relics.name: 万木归根
relics.text: 我方后阵单位具有[远射]。
relics.flavor: 根扎得越深，枝伸得越远。

art.subject: an ancient tree root knot glowing green from within, its tendrils reaching outward like drawn bows, forest dusk

relics.name: 离魂灯
relics.text: 每当友方单位入场，使其获得[隐匿]。
relics.flavor: 灯照不到的地方，才是它们的来处。

art.subject: a paper lantern with a cold violet flame, casting no light, faint translucent figures stepping out of its shadow

relics.name: 焚天炉心
relics.text: 敌方角色身上的[灼烧]不再衰减。
relics.flavor: 焚阳宗的祖炉从未熄过。被它点着的，也不会。

art.subject: a pulsing molten core inside a cracked black iron furnace heart, rivers of fire flowing from its seams

relics.name: 雷音铜鼓
relics.text: 友方单位具有[疾行]。
relics.flavor: 鼓一响，没有人等得及。

art.subject: a large bronze war drum with frog figures on its rim, shockwaves of lightning rippling out from the drumhead

relics.name: 玄武背甲
relics.text: 我方角色的[护甲]在回合开始时不再清零。
relics.flavor: 玄武驮着北方的山。它从不卸下什么。

art.subject: a massive dark tortoise shell plate carved with constellations of the north, a coiled serpent motif around its rim, cold light

relics.name: 双锋剑匣
relics.text: 你的主帅具有[连斩]（每回合可以武器攻击两次）。
relics.flavor: 匣中两剑，一剑问，一剑答。

art.subject: an open lacquered black sword case holding two identical slender swords side by side, their edges catching red light

relics.name: 双耳祭鼎
relics.text: 每回合可以献牌为源2次。
relics.flavor: 一耳敬天，一耳敬己。

art.subject: a heavy bronze ritual cauldron with two upright handles, two thin streams of offering smoke rising and glowing

relics.name: 地宫虎符
relics.text: 友方单位+1攻击力。
relics.flavor: 半枚在你手里，另半枚在地下的某位王手里。兵只认符。

art.subject: half of a bronze tiger-shaped military tally inlaid with gold script, the split edge glowing faintly

relics.name: 鸩羽扇
relics.text: 敌方受到的[中毒]伤害+1。每回合开始时，对随机敌人施加2层[中毒]。
relics.flavor: 扇一下是风，扇两下是命。

art.subject: a folding fan made of dark violet poison-bird feathers, green droplets beading on the tips, held half open

relics.name: 百工宝匣
relics.text: 战斗奖励中的卡牌均已升级。
relics.flavor: 匣中百件器物，件件都经过第二道工。

art.subject: an open craftsman's treasure chest filled with tiny finely worked tools and gleaming finished trinkets, warm workshop light

relics.name: 地宫拍卖槌
relics.text: 每击败一名精英，额外获得1件遗物。
relics.flavor: 地下的拍卖行只收一种货：从强者身上扒下来的。

art.subject: a carved dark wooden auction gavel resting on a bronze sound block, shadowy bidders' masks in the background

relics.name: 净业铜盆
relics.text: 商店移除卡牌的价格降低50%。
relics.flavor: 洗手的水倒掉，业也就少了一点。

art.subject: a shallow bronze washbasin filled with clear water, a single ink-stained card dissolving into it, soft light

relics.name: 掌柜的铁算盘
relics.text: 商店中所有商品价格降低20%。
relics.flavor: 珠子是铁的，拨起来响，砍价也响。

art.subject: a heavy black iron abacus with worn beads, a merchant's hand flicking one bead, coins scattered on a counter

relics.name: 九转药葫
relics.text: 丹药栏位+2。
relics.flavor: 葫芦里九道弯，每道弯藏一颗丹。

art.subject: a large lacquered medicine gourd with nine carved spiral bands, a red cord and small pill bottles hanging from it

relics.name: 说书人醒木
relics.text: 战斗开始时，从抽牌堆中选择1张牌加入手牌。
relics.flavor: 啪的一声，故事就翻到了你想听的那一回。

art.subject: a polished rectangular wooden gavel block of a storyteller slammed on a table, a folding fan beside it, teahouse lamplight

relics.name: 山鬼骨笛

relics.flavor: 吹的是山里死去的风，唤回的是山里没走远的魂。

art.subject: a bone flute carved from a deer antler, wrapped with a strand of red cord and dried fig leaves, pale green mist curling from its finger holes

relics.name: 断焰刀鞘

relics.flavor: 刀断了，鞘还留着那一截的形状。

art.subject: a battered crimson leather scabbard wrapped in iron bands, lying open with a faint orange glow leaking from its mouth

relics.name: 柳絮扇
relics.text: 你的手牌上限+2。战斗开始时，抽2张牌。
relics.flavor: 扇面上的人，每次打开都不一样。

art.subject: a half-open folding fan painted with a faceless woman beneath willow branches, catkins seeming to drift off the paper, soft lamplight

relics.name: 朱雀翎
relics.text: 战斗开始时，将一张火种置入手牌。
relics.flavor: 祭司把它插在发间，它便每天替她落下一粒火。

art.subject: a single long vermilion tail feather floating upright in darkness, its tip smoldering and shedding one glowing ember

relics.name: 万灵种囊
relics.text: 你的回合开始时，若你拥有至少3个友方单位，抽1张牌。
relics.flavor: 囊里的种子会自己数人头，人够了，就吐一粒出来。

art.subject: a small embroidered pouch of green silk bulging with glowing seeds, a few tiny sprouts poking out of its drawstring mouth, resting on moss

relics.name: 山君石心
relics.text: 战斗开始时，获得3点[护甲]。
relics.flavor: 从护山大阵阵眼里取出的一块石头，摸上去是温的。

art.subject: a fist-sized grey stone shaped like a heart with a faint mountain vein pattern glowing warm blue inside, resting on a folded dark cloth

relics.name: 冰蚕弦
relics.text: 每当你在应对中打出牌，获得3点[护甲]。
relics.flavor: 冰蚕吐的丝，弹一声，寒三分。

art.subject: a coil of translucent silk string spun by an ice silkworm, glittering with frost, the small pale silkworm resting on the coil, close-up on dark wood

relics.name: 浑天铜签
relics.text: 战斗开始时，收取1张[命签]。每当你[改判]，获得4点[护甲]。
relics.flavor: 浑天仪拆下来的一根铜杆，被他削成了签。

art.subject: a slender bronze rod broken from an armillary sphere, carved into a fortune slip, lying on dark velvet with faint star engravings

relics.name: 龟甲卦筒
relics.text: 每回合你首次打出[延时]牌后，抽1张牌。
relics.flavor: 筒里的龟甲早就裂完了，裂纹比卦辞还多。

art.subject: a worn cylinder made from a tortoise shell, cracked all over, with three bronze coins and a folded talisman peeking out of the top

relics.name: 昙香囊
relics.text: 敌人受到的[中毒]伤害+1。
relics.flavor: 香囊里装的不是花，是花谢之后剩下的东西。

art.subject: a small embroidered violet sachet tied with black cord, a withered white night flower peeking out, faint green vapor seeping from the seams

relics.name: 沉渊夜明珠
relics.text: 每当你的弃牌堆洗入抽牌堆，获得1枚本回合的[源]。
relics.flavor: 沉渊城的珠子，越是转回原处，越亮。

art.subject: a luminous pearl glowing pale blue at the bottom of dark water, drowned palace ruins faint behind it

relics.name: 命阙石阶
relics.text: 揭示地图上的所有节点。
relics.flavor: 向下的台阶，每一级都刻着下一级的名字。

art.subject: a single carved stone stair step engraved with a tiny map of descending floors, lit from below by faint gold

relics.name: 血玉扳指
relics.text: 每当你的主帅发动攻击，恢复2点生命。
relics.flavor: 扳指勒进指节，每拉一次弓，就还你一口血。

art.subject: a deep red blood jade archer's thumb ring with swirling veins, on a gloved thumb drawing a bowstring

relics.name: 断刃残谱
relics.text: 每当你装备一件装备，获得1层[锋锐]。
relics.flavor: 谱上只剩起手式。够了。

art.subject: a torn martial arts manual with ink drawings of sword stances, a broken blade tip lying on its open pages

relics.name: 青铜命盘
relics.text: 每回合开始时，[观星]2。
relics.flavor: 盘上的指针不是指向天，是指向下一张牌。

art.subject: an ancient bronze divination disc with concentric rings of star symbols and a spoon-shaped pointer, lit by candle

relics.name: 寒潭磨剑石
relics.text: 战斗开始时，获得2层[锋锐]。
relics.flavor: 石头在潭底泡了三百年，磨出的刃不沾血。

art.subject: a smooth dark whetstone half submerged in an icy pool, a sword edge gleaming as it is drawn across it

relics.name: 王朝残玺
relics.text: 卡牌奖励多提供1个选项。
relics.flavor: 盖了印的诏书，总会多给一条出路。

art.subject: a cracked imperial jade seal with a coiled beast handle, a corner broken off, red cinnabar on its base

relics.name: 回光铜镜
relics.text: 你的[应]牌费用-1。
relics.flavor: 镜中人总比你快半步出手。

art.subject: a round bronze mirror with a coiled dragon back, its surface showing a hand already raised to block, dim blue light

relics.name: 幽弈残局
relics.text: 每当你弃置一张牌（包括回合结束时的弃牌），对随机敌人施加1层[中毒]。
relics.flavor: 弃子不是输，是把毒藏进对方的棋路。

art.subject: a go board mid-game with violet and black stones, faint green venom seeping from the captured stones, candlelit

relics.name: 冰魄玉蝉
relics.text: 每当你的主帅[护甲]被击破，对造成伤害者施加1层[冰冻]。
relics.flavor: 玉蝉含在口中，寒气便从伤口里反扑出去。

art.subject: a translucent pale jade cicada carving covered in frost crystals, cold vapor rising from its wings

relics.name: 地宫账簿
relics.text: 获得的金币+25%。
relics.flavor: 地下王国的账，一笔都没算错过。

art.subject: a thick mildewed account book open to pages of neat columns, a brass abacus beside it, lantern light underground

relics.name: 连环扣
relics.text: 每回合你打出第5张牌时，获得1枚本回合的[源]并抽1张牌。
relics.flavor: 五个环扣在一起，才解得开。

art.subject: five interlocking silver rings forming a chain puzzle, glowing faintly where they link, on a dark velvet cloth

relics.name: 行脚铜钵
relics.text: 拾取时，从牌组中移除2张牌。
relics.flavor: 行脚僧的钵里只装一顿饭。多余的，都得放下。

art.subject: a battered copper alms bowl held in weathered hands, empty, on a dusty mountain road at dusk

relics.name: 镇岳阵旗
relics.text: 我方前阵单位具有[坚守]。
relics.flavor: 旗插在哪里，哪里就是山门。

art.subject: a tattered dark blue war banner embroidered with a mountain emblem planted in rocky ground, wind whipping it

relics.name: 轮回种囊
relics.text: 每当友方单位死亡，随机一个友方单位获得+2/+1。
relics.flavor: 落叶不是死，是把力气交给下一棵。

art.subject: a small linen seed pouch spilling glowing green seeds onto dark soil where tiny sprouts are rising

relics.name: 金阁签筒
relics.text: [命签]上限+1。每当你[改判]，抽1张牌。
relics.flavor: 签筒摇三下，落出来的那支，替你把天意换掉。

art.subject: a gilded bamboo fortune-stick cylinder tilted mid-shake, one stick leaping out glowing with starlight

relics.name: 灵泉玉壶
relics.text: 敌方回合开始时，你每有1枚[余烬]，获得2点[护甲]。
relics.flavor: 壶里的水不多，留着的都是救命的。

art.subject: a small white jade teapot with spring water glowing inside, steam rising, a few glowing ember-like coals beside it

relics.name: 星轨算筹
relics.text: 你方[判定]的点数+2（至多13，用于高低与点数段结算）。以敌方为对象的判定不受影响。
relics.flavor: 观星阁的算筹多刻了两道。多出来的，是人意。

art.subject: a bundle of golden counting rods engraved with star orbits, laid in a pattern on a dark star chart, gentle gold glow

relics.name: 焚阳刀穗
relics.text: 你的主帅具有[奇袭]（武器攻击无视深度与[坚守]）。
relics.flavor: 刀穗一扬，火从阵缝里钻进去。

art.subject: a long crimson silk sword tassel with a flame-shaped jade bead, whipping through the air trailing sparks

relics.name: 镇墓兽角
relics.text: 每当你的主帅受到攻击，对攻击者造成3点伤害。
relics.flavor: 它守过一座王陵。现在它守着你。

art.subject: a single curved horn broken from a stone tomb guardian beast, carved with snarling patterns, dust and dim torchlight

potions.name: 破甲符

art.subject: a crimson-inked talisman pressed against cracked armor, fracture lines of light spreading from it

art.subject: a small paper packet spilling sickly green powder that curls into a skull-shaped cloud, dark alley

potions.name: 焚身符
potions.text: 对一个敌人施加6层[灼烧]。

art.subject: a yellow paper talisman with red brush script bursting into flame mid-air as it flies forward

potions.name: 清心丹

potions.name: 散功符

art.subject: a grey talisman unfurling into drifting smoke ribbons that wrap around shadowy warriors, their weapons drooping

potions.name: 聚灵丹
potions.text: 获得2枚本回合的[源]。

potions.name: 赤焰丹
potions.text: 对一个敌人造成12点伤害。

potions.text: 恢复15点生命。可在地图上使用。

potions.text: 获得2层[锋锐]。
